sort_by.description:
Field used to sort address result sets.

Permitted values match indexed/address book relevance fields. Defaults to 'created_at' if not specified.

oneOf.description:
Sort order for the result set, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').

Applies to the selected sort_by field. Default is 'desc'.

Sort order for the result set, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').

Applies to the selected sort_by field. Default is 'desc'.

order.description:
Sort order for the result set, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').

Applies to the selected sort_by field. Default is 'desc'.

IShoppingMallAddress.IRequest.description:
Filter, search, sorting, and pagination options for fetching customer/seller address records from shopping_mall_addresses.

Clients provide these fields as request parameters to control the subset, order, and amount of address book data returned. All criteria must match existing fields of shopping_mall_addresses; extra filters are not permitted. This schema is used by endpoints listing or searching customer/seller addresses, but does not create, update, or delete records. Parameters are optional unless otherwise stated; absence means no filtering on that field.

IShoppingMallAddress.description:
Represents a structured address record in the shopping mall system, providing shipping, billing, or business association information for either a customer or seller.

Each address details the recipient's full name, structured street address, city, province/state, postal code, country, and phone. Addresses are owned by either a customer or seller but never both. The record tracks if it is the default address and logs the creation timestamp. Soft deletes are not supported: addresses are permanent unless deleted by explicit admin or owner action.

Used in account profile management for checkout, shipping, tax documentation, and seller onboarding. Ownership is enforced strictly by authentication context and business logic.

Relations: Linked either to a customer (shopping_mall_customer_id) or a seller (shopping_mall_seller_id); foreign key fields are exclusive, and at least one must be set.

All properties closely follow the database schema definitions and may appear in Admin/Seller/Customer views depending on context.

id.description:
Primary key identifier for the address record.

Each address is uniquely identified by a UUID. Used for internal references, updating, or deleting entries. Must match the corresponding database row's primary key.

full_name.description:
Recipient's name as designated for shipping or billing.

This is the full delivery or invoice name provided by the address owner, e.g., John Doe, Maria Lee. It is mandatory and validated per international address rules.

street.description:
Street address including building number, apartment, or suite specification.

May include multiple lines if required by local address formats. Examples: '123 Maple Ave Apt 4B', '1600 Amphitheatre Parkway'.

city.description:
City or locality for delivery and location purposes.

Always required and validated against postal rules of the target country/region.

province.description:
Province, state, or administrative region. Required for many international or domestic shipments.

May be labeled as 'State', 'Province', 'Region', or 'Prefecture' depending on country.

postal_code.description:
Postal/ZIP code for the address, formatted according to the recipient country.

Could include dashes, spaces, or other country-specific symbols.

country.description:
Country in ISO 3166-1 format or relevant local language name.

Data should either be a standard ISO name/code or a platform-supported country string to ensure shipping compliance.

phone.description:
Contact phone number for delivery confirmation or issues.

Typically required for courier communications. Validated using international phone number conventions; must be reachable.

is_default.description:
Flag indicating whether this is the owner's default address.

Only one address per user may be marked as default at a time. Automatically set/unset on creation/update.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the address record was created in the system.

Populated automatically at the moment of entry creation. Used for audit and ordering purposes.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description:
Foreign key UUID referencing the owning customer if this address belongs to a customer, else null.

Exclusive with shopping_mall_seller_id; only one may be filled. Used to scope addresses for customer operations. Null if not a customer address.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description:
Foreign key UUID referencing the owning seller if this address belongs to a seller, else null.

Exclusive with shopping_mall_customer_id; only one may be filled. Used to scope addresses for seller operations. Null if not a seller address.

IShoppingMallAddress.IUpdate.description:
Represents the data required to update an existing address entry in the shopping mall system for either a customer or seller actor.

Accepts only mutable structured address fields required for shipping, billing, or business operations. All fields are required for strict completeness and to ensure data integrity. Foreign key fields for ownership context (shopping_mall_customer_id or shopping_mall_seller_id) are never requested in the update body—the system assumes owner context from the path.

Intended for use in admin, seller, or customer address management flows where the actor is authorized to make changes. On successful update, all address fields must be validated according to platform and international conventions. The is_default flag ensures the default address logic is maintained. Timestamps and record IDs are system-managed and excluded.

full_name.description: Updated recipient's name for the address. Must not be empty and should comply with business validation rules.

street.description: Updated street address. Required per address update rules; must provide valid new value.

city.description: Updated city or locality for the address record.

province.description: Updated province, state, or administrative subdivision for the address.

postal_code.description: Updated postal code. Constrained by format of destination country or region.

country.description: Updated country value. Typically follows ISO or business-approved nomenclature.

phone.description: Updated phone number. Must allow valid courier or shipping agent contact.

is_default.description: Whether this address should become the new default for the owner after update. Platform will unset previous defaults as needed.

email.description:
Filter by seller's email address (full or partial match).

Allows searching for sellers using the registered email address as recorded in the shopping_mall_sellers entity. If provided, filters result set to sellers where email contains the specified value. Case-insensitive matching is supported for broad search usability.

This field is optional for general admin dashboard use, primarily used when seeking specific accounts with known contact information.

business_name.description:
Filter by legal business name of the seller (partial match enabled).

Enables searching sellers whose registered business_name matches (partially or fully) the given input. Useful for admin exploratory search and verification. Case-insensitive substring matching is supported. This aligns with the gin index in the underlying database for efficiency.

This filter helps quickly identify or audit businesses by name as displayed on the platform.

registration_number.description:
Filter by government-issued business registration number.

Helps admins and compliance processes quickly locate businesses by precise registration/identification number as required for KYC or regulatory checks. Supports full string matching.

status.description:
Filter by account status.

Allows searching sellers by current workflow/account status. Typical values are 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'suspended', etc. (as enforced by business logic and admin workflows). Limit the results to only those sellers currently in the specified status.

is_email_verified.description:
Filter by email verification status.

If provided, restricts results to only those accounts whose email verification flag matches the input (true=verified, false=unverified). Used for oversight and compliance processing.

created_from.description:
Filter by earliest account creation date/time (inclusive).

If provided, only sellers created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp will be returned. Used to time-bound search results for audits or reports. Expressed in UTC.

created_to.description:
Filter by latest account creation date/time (inclusive).

Limits results to sellers created at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Used to constrain results for date-based analysis or reporting. UTC format.

updated_from.description:
Filter by earliest last-update timestamp.

If specified, only sellers with updates at or after this UTC timestamp are included. For tracking recent changes or admin updates.

updated_to.description:
Filter by latest last-update timestamp.

Only sellers whose updated_at is at or before this UTC time are included. Useful for reviewing recently modified sellers within a range.

sort_by.description:
Primary sort key for results.

Determines the column/field to sort on in the database: 'business_name', 'email', 'status', 'created_at', 'updated_at', etc. Default depends on admin UI requirements; commonly business_name or created_at.

oneOf.description:
Sort direction: ascending or descending order.

As specified by the admin in the dashboard interface. Allowed values: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.

Sort direction: ascending or descending order.

As specified by the admin in the dashboard interface. Allowed values: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.

sort_direction.description:
Sort direction: ascending or descending order.

As specified by the admin in the dashboard interface. Allowed values: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.

page.description:
Page number of the result set (1-based).

Supports standard offset-based pagination for large result sets. Default is 1 if not specified.

page_size.description:
Number of records per page.

Sets the size of each returned page in the result set. Restricted to a reasonable maximum (typically 100) for performance. Default may be 20/50 as per admin UX guidelines.

IShoppingMallSeller.IRequest.description:
Request body schema for paginated, filtered, and sorted search of shopping mall sellers.

Enables flexible query building for the shopping_mall_sellers admin listing endpoint, supporting multi-criteria search, partial string matching, unique constraint lookups, and time-bounded results. Includes sorting and paging properties to optimize large-scale admin UI/workflows. Aligns with admin dashboard needs for compliance, support, and business operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for this seller. Primary key in the shopping_mall_sellers table.

email.description: Seller's unique login email. Used for authentication and the main point of contact as defined in the shopping_mall_sellers Prisma model. Uniqueness is enforced at the database layer. Visible to admins for identification and communication.

business_name.description: Legal business name of the seller, required for platform usage and public catalog display. Reflects the official registration with authorities. Enforced as not-null in the database.

registration_number.description: Government-issued registration/license number. Used for platform KYC, compliance, and legal reporting. Uniqueness enforced. May be cross-verified by admins or compliance bots.

business_phone.description: Official business contact phone for admin, customer support, and platform notifications. Registered with the seller account and modifiable by authorized actors. Not-null required.

is_email_verified.description: Indicates whether seller has completed email verification. Set by system during onboarding or password recovery; enforced for compliance and product listing eligibility. Boolean flag as defined in the Prisma schema.

status.description: Current seller workflow/account status such as: pending, approved, rejected, suspended, etc. Used in admin workflows for onboarding, compliance, and business lifecycle. Required string as described in the shopping_mall_sellers Prisma model.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the seller account was created in the platform. Used for audit, reporting, and business logic.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp for the last update to the seller account. Reflects last admin modification or business-initiated change.

IShoppingMallSeller.description:
Detailed schema for a registered seller account ('shopping_mall_sellers' table).

Represents a legally registered seller within the shopping mall ecosystem, including core identity, business information, legal compliance, and status tracking. All properties are present in the primary underpinning database model as detailed in its comments.

Immutable and compliance-sensitive fields (id, registration_number) are enforced as read-only. The entity is foundational for seller dashboards, onboarding, support, legal reporting, and admin platform functionality.

email.description:
Seller's unique login email. Used for authentication and main point of contact.

This value must be unique across all sellers in the system. Updates to the email require re-verification of the address before the account regains active status. Business notifications and administrative correspondence will be sent to this address. Follows RFC 5322 standard email validation.

business_name.description:
Legal business name of the seller account.

Must match the registered business identity and will be used for all compliance, product catalogs, and public display purposes. Changes are generally limited and may require administrative review for regulatory compliance.

registration_number.description:
Government-issued business registration or license number.

This number is used for KYC (Know Your Customer) and legal compliance. Changes to this field may be blocked if the account has been verified, and must be unique among all sellers.

business_phone.description:
Official business contact phone number for support and notifications.

Used as the primary number for service-related contacts, support calls, or emergency notification. Must support validation (E.164 recommended format) and should be reachable by system administrators.

is_email_verified.description:
Indicates whether seller has verified their email address.

Only system workflows or administrative actors should set this field. Sellers cannot self-update this property.

status.description:
Seller account status: pending, approved, rejected, suspended, etc.

Docs must enumerate all allowed status values for workflow enforcement. Only authorized system processes or admins can set compliance-related statuses. Field updates are auditable.

IShoppingMallSeller.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating a registered shopping mall seller account.

Allows modification of mutable fields according to business compliance and security policies. Only authorized processes and administrators may call this operation.

Immutable fields such as account ID and historical verification/compliance records cannot be changed via this DTO.

Properties reference the latest Prisma schema definitions and must preserve field-level business logic, uniqueness, and relationship constraints.

Refer to related documentation for update process workflow and security best practices.

page.description:
Page number for pagination.

Must be a positive integer representing the results page to return. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records per page.

Must be a positive integer and is bounded by system-level maximum (100 for this endpoint). Defaults to 20 if not specified. Used for efficient pagination of session records.

start_at.description:
Start of session creation date range filter (inclusive), expressed as ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

Sessions created before this time are excluded from the results. Used for time-based filtering in session audit queries.

end_at.description:
End of session creation date range filter (exclusive), in ISO 8601 UTC.

Sessions created after this timestamp are excluded from the result set. Used to limit session window during device or security analysis.

ip.description:
IP address filter for session records (partial match enabled).

Allows filtering sessions by origin IP address. Partial and exact matches are supported to enable subnet or device-specific queries. String matching is case-insensitive and accepts IPv4 or IPv6 without strict pattern enforcements.

expired.description:
Filter for session expiration status.

If true, only expired sessions are returned. If false, only active (non-expired) sessions are included. Omitting the field returns all sessions regardless of status.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.IRequest.description:
DTO for searching and paginating seller session records in the shopping mall platform.

Supports pagination (page, limit) and advanced filters such as creation time window (start_at, end_at), originating IP address, and expiration state. Used in endpoints that analyze, audit, or display seller session records in admin or seller dashboards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the session record. Primary Key from the shopping_mall_seller_sessions table. Used for referencing this authentication event across audit and dashboard systems.

seller.description: Reference object for the seller entity (IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary) who owns this session. Follows BELONGS-TO transformation: provides minimal summary context for the owning seller, eliminating the raw UUID FK, and supports atomic information in responses.

ip.description: IP address from which this session originated. Used for security monitoring and location-based analysis. Stored as plain text. Cleared only by session expiration or log purge policies.

href.description: Source URL of the session creation event. Used to capture context for login flows, sometimes indicating device/browser or client environment. Must be a full URI.

referrer.description: Referrer URL at time of login. Used to track how session was initiated (e.g., from landing page, direct link, or prior session). Must be a valid URL or an empty string if no referrer.

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp, stored in UTC. Used for access history, audit trails, and business compliance.

expired_at.description: Datetime at which the session expired or became inactive. Null if session is ongoing/active. Used for checking timeout, logout, or invalidation events.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.description:
Represents an authenticated seller session within the shopping mall platform.

Tracks metadata for each login event by a seller account including creation context, linkage to the seller, security/audit trail information, device/browser environment, and explicit session expiry details. Sessions are referenced by other business entities for compliance and access management. All actions by the seller through the dashboard/API are session-scoped and traceable.

This type is used in audit logs, session management flows, and security reviews. Sensitive for security, exposure must be restricted to the owner or authorized administrative actors.

The BELONGS-TO seller relation is provided via seller object (IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary), not raw UUID foreign key, for reference object atomic completeness.

status.description: Filter by seller verification status. Allowed values include: pending, approved, rejected, under_review, needs_more_info. When omitted, no status filtering is applied.

date_from.description: Filters verifications created on or after this date (inclusive). Must be a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format. If omitted or null, no lower bound is applied.

date_to.description: Filters verifications created on or before this date (inclusive). Must be a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format. If omitted or null, no upper bound is applied.

reviewer_admin_id.description: UUID of the admin who reviewed the verification. Used for filtering by reviewer. Leave null or omit for no reviewer filtering.

compliance_document_present.description: If true, only verifications with uploaded compliance documents are included. If false, only those with no compliance documentation. Null or omitted for no filter.

page.description: Results pagination: page index (1-based). Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum records per paginated page. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g., 'created_at', 'status'). Optional; defaults to created_at if omitted.

oneOf.description: Sort order for the results. Allowed values are 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc'.
Sort order for the results. Allowed values are 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc'.

sort_order.description: Sort order for the results. Allowed values are 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc'.

IShoppingMallSellerVerification.IRequest.description:
Paginated, filterable search request for seller verification records (KYC/compliance history).

Allows querying the shopping_mall_seller_verifications table for all verifications pertaining to a given seller, with filters by status, creation/review dates, reviewing admin, whether compliance documents have been attached, and sort/pagination.

This enables dashboard and workflow UIs to provide sellers and admins with audit history, workflow compliance, and status review for business verification requests.

id.description:
Primary Key.

Unique identifier for this seller verification record. Used as the reference for audit trails, workflow progression, and permissions enforcement.

seller.description:
Reference to the seller under verification.

Provides immediate, context-rich access to the associated seller's summary information. Replaces the primitive foreign key UUID field for direct FK transformation compliance and atomic read context.

reviewer_admin.description:
Reference to the admin who reviewed or verified this record.

Contains key contextual summary information for the assigned reviewer/compliance officer (IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary), rather than a raw reviewer_admin_id UUID. Enables full traceability and UI display without extra API queries; null if pending/unassigned.

status.description:
Verification status of this record: pending, approved, rejected, under_review, needs_more_info, etc.

Tracks the current state in the KYC/business verification workflow. Enum values must be enforced application-side as business logic, not open input for non-admin actors.

compliance_documents.description:
Documentation references or IDs submitted for KYC or compliance.

May be null during initial request. When present, contains structured information or external document URLs/IDs as designated by requirements.

reason.description:
Notes explaining state, rejection, or administrative requirements.

May be null if not needed; supplied by admins during review or by the system in automated workflow transitions.

reviewed_at.description:
Datetime when this record was reviewed/decisioned.

May be null if not yet reviewed. Set only when status transitions past pending.

created_at.description:
Record creation timestamp.

Indicates when this seller verification was initially submitted; set in UTC by the system at insertion.

IShoppingMallSellerVerification.description:
Seller KYC/business verification record (shopping_mall_seller_verifications).

Represents a seller's submitted verification request for identity/compliance purposes. Each record contains the verification status, compliance artifact references, reviewer/admin assignment, explanatory notes or reasons, and canonical timestamps for auditing. The associated seller and reviewer admin are directly referenced via summary objects for atomic operation completeness. All transitions and notes recorded for audit traceability. Append-only for strong historical trace and regulatory compliance.

status.description:
Verification status to update (pending, approved, rejected, under_review, needs_more_info, etc.).

Enumerated workflow states as specified in business logic. Only updatable by admin actors. Must respect workflow transition policies (e.g., no illegal backtracking or skipping required states).

compliance_documents.description:
Updated documentation references or IDs for KYC/compliance.

Include or update document references when compliance officer/automation processes new or corrected submissions.

reason.description:
Update to explanation or notes regarding verification record (e.g., rejection reason, special requirements).

Can be updated during workflow transitions.

reviewed_at.description:
Timestamp indicating when the verification was reviewed.

Set to current time by admin when changing workflow state, or cleared if pending. Only settable by admin through this mutation.

reviewer_admin_id.description:
UUID of the admin who acted on this verification (references shopping_mall_admins).

Set by compliance/review workflow when assigning or updating the responsible reviewer/admin. May be cleared to null for pending/unassigned.

IShoppingMallSellerVerification.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating (admin-only) seller verification record fields in shopping_mall_seller_verifications.

Allows privileged actors (admin/compliance officer) to alter verification status, annotate compliance documents, provide workflow/rejection notes, and assign or record reviewer/admin IDs. All mutation fields are optional so consumers may submit partial updates as allowed by the API. Enforces regulatory and workflow constraints as per compliance requirements; unauthorized or invalid transitions should be rejected server-side.

email.description: Filter for admin email address. Allows exact or partial match when searching administrator accounts. Uses full text index for efficiency.

name.description: Filter for admin's full name. Allows exact or partial name search; uses gin index for partial matches and case-insensitive lookup.

status.description: Filter for admin account status. Accepts one or more status values (comma separated), e.g., 'active', 'suspended', or 'revoked'.

is_email_verified.description: Filter for email verification/activation status. If true, only retrieves admins with verified emails.

created_from.description: Filter for admin accounts created after this ISO8601 timestamp (inclusive). Used for time-windowed searches.

created_to.description: Filter for admin accounts created before this ISO8601 timestamp (inclusive). Used for time-windowed searches.

updated_from.description: Filter for admin accounts updated after this ISO8601 timestamp (inclusive).

updated_to.description: Filter for admin accounts updated before this ISO8601 timestamp (inclusive).

page.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 20; maximum allowed is 100.

sort_by.description: Field by which results should be sorted. Options: 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'email', 'name', 'status'. Defaults to 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order for results, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Defaults to 'desc'.
Sort order for results, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Defaults to 'desc'.

sort_order.description: Sort order for results, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Defaults to 'desc'.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IRequest.description:
Administrator account search, filter, and pagination criteria for platform governance workflows.

Enables authorized admin actors to search the shopping_mall_admins table using email/name (partial match), account status, verification status, and date windows. Also supports paging and sorting by key fields.

Strict access control ensures only privileged root admin users may search admin registry records. Valid fields are derived from the admin schema and indexed for large-scale audit and compliance queries.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID primary key) of the admin account.

email.description: Unique admin email address for authentication and contact. Must be unique per administrator and is required for account communications.

name.description: Full name of the administrator for auditing, contact, and action logs.

is_email_verified.description: Whether the admin's email has been verified and the account is fully activated. Controls access to privileged functions.

status.description: Current account status, such as active, suspended, or revoked. Controls the admin's platform access and privileges.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. System-managed for audit history.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to the admin account. System-managed for audit and rollback.

IShoppingMallAdmin.description:
Full platform administrator account record as stored in shopping_mall_admins.

Contains all non-sensitive fields: email, name, account status, verification state, and account lifecycle timestamps. Excludes password_hash or authentication secrets.

Required for audit, compliance, and platform governance workflows. Returned when querying a single admin or after updates. Changes to authentication data (e.g., password_hash) are always managed securely and never exposed in API responses.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IUpdate.description:
Administrator account update DTO for modifying platform admin attributes.

Used by authorized admins to update email (unique, required), name, email verification status, account status, and (optionally) password for the admin identified by adminId in the path parameter. Email changes demand uniqueness checks. No ownership or system fields allowed—id, created_at, updated_at, and system-managed audit fields are forbidden here. Only business-editable fields present. Updates are strictly restricted to authenticated admins, and system automatically manages updated_at timestamp and auditing. Forbidden fields: id, created_at, updated_at, password_hash (backend only), any authentication or audit fields. The password field in this DTO is for plain password (write-only) use, never exposed in responses. Prevents self-admin demotion or revocation by active users, follows admin update business rules.

email.description: New unique email for the admin account. Must remain unique across all platform admins. Changes undergo uniqueness validation by the system and are subject to business constraints. Required when updating email; omitted if not changing.

name.description: Administrator's full name to update for auditing, contact, and display. Can be edited by privileged admins only.

password.description: Optional new password for the administrator account, provided as plain text. Backend will hash it securely before storage. Never exposed in any response. Use only to update password securely. Not required if password is not being changed.

is_email_verified.description: Indicate if the administrator's email is verified/activated. Business rules might prevent revoking verified status without strong justification.

status.description: Status value to update account accessibility. E.g., active, suspended, revoked. Must match permissible statuses in business rules. Prevents self-demotion via API.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.IRequest.description:
Admin session search/filter query DTO for paginated session log retrieval.

Used in PATCH /shoppingMall/admin/admins/{adminId}/sessions operation for filtering, sorting, and paginating logged sessions for an administrator. Search and filter fields include IP, referrer, href, date/time ranges, and standard pagination keys. Does not accept any audit, system, or actor fields. All criteria must comply with platform search business rules. Designed for compliance, audit, and security review scenarios.

ip.description: Optional filter to search sessions by originating IP address. If provided, restricts results to sessions started from this IP.

referrer.description: Optional filter for referrer URL at session login. If specified, session logs must match this referrer.

href.description: Optional filter for entry URL at session login. If specified, session logs must match this URL.

created_from.description: Start date/time filter for session creation timestamps (inclusive). Sessions must have created_at >= this value.

created_to.description: End date/time filter for session creation timestamps (inclusive). Sessions must have created_at <= this value.

page.description: Result page index for paginated queries. Starts at 1. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Number of session records per page. Defaults to 20. Maximum value enforced by system constraints.

sort_by.description: Key to sort session logs, such as 'created_at', 'ip', or 'referrer'. Platform will map values to index, must match allowed sortable fields.

oneOf.description: Sort direction for results. Must be either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending. Defaults to 'desc' (most recent first).
Sort direction for results. Must be either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending. Defaults to 'desc' (most recent first).

sort_order.description: Sort direction for results. Must be either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending. Defaults to 'desc' (most recent first).

IShoppingMallAdminSession.description:
Represents an individual admin dashboard/API session log within the shopping mall platform.

This schema provides complete details about a single session for an admin user, including session identifiers, IP address, entry URLs, and timestamps related to session lifecycle. Each session is strictly linked to one admin account, enabling forensic review and compliance tracking for privileged access events.

Used for viewing, auditing, and analyzing privileged administrative actions and for security monitoring workflows.

id.description: Unique identifier for the admin session record. Primary key from the shopping_mall_admin_sessions table.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Unique identifier for the admin user who owns this session. Foreign key referencing shopping_mall_admins.id.

ip.description: Originating IP address for this session, provided at login and used for security/audit purposes.

href.description: Access URL used at the start of the session, providing context on admin entry point.

referrer.description: Referrer URL when login occurred, indicating user flow into the admin session.

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp (ISO 8601). Indicates when the session was established.

oneOf.description: Session expiration timestamp (ISO 8601) if session has expired.
Null if session is active and not yet expired.

expired_at.description: Datetime when session expires, or null if session is currently active. Used to determine session state in compliance reviews.

admin.description: Reference to the admin who owns this session. Provides minimal identifying information for audit and traceability.

IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary.description:
Summary profile for a system administrator (admin) within the shopping mall platform. This schema is used exclusively for minimal references in other objects—especially as a nested or foreign relation when displaying administrative actors linked to privileged actions, audit logs, or session records.

The summary includes only the core identifiers needed to establish a clear, auditable link between privileged operations and administrator actors in business workflows. This facilitates fast lookups and compact display in lists, logs, or references while still maintaining business-critical traceability and compliance context.

By using the summary view, the platform foundation ensures efficient embedding of admin context in deeply-nested entities, supporting security, monitoring, and end-user attribution requirements. This approach also supports future extensibility if additional summary-level admin fields become crucial for expanded compliance or analytics use cases.

id.description: Unique identifier for this admin user.

name.description: Full display name of the admin as it should appear in audit logs and user context.

email.description: Contact email address of the admin user. Used for support, compliance, or audit communication.

IShoppingMallRoleEscalation.IRequest.description:
Search, filtering, and pagination criteria for retrieving admin role escalation and privilege change events.

Specifies optional filters by status, target role, requestor identity, and time ranges, with support for pagination and sort direction. Used in PATCH /shoppingMall/admin/roleEscalations to enumerate past or pending role escalation requests for compliance or governance review.

status.description: Filter by escalation status (e.g., pending, approved, rejected, under_review, revoked). Optional.

target_role.description: Target role being requested for escalation (e.g., seller, admin). Optional.

requestor_actor_id.description: Filter by initiating customer, if set. UUID for customer. Optional.

requestor_seller_id.description: Filter by initiating seller, if set. UUID for seller. Optional.

processed_by_admin_id.description: Filter by admin who processed the escalation event. UUID for admin staff. Optional.

created_from.description: Start of creation datetime range (inclusive) for filtering events. Optional.

created_to.description: End of creation datetime range (inclusive). Optional.

processed_from.description: Start of processed datetime range (inclusive). Optional.

processed_to.description: End of processed datetime range (inclusive). Optional.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Number of records per page, for pagination. Defaults to a sensible backend value if not provided.

oneOf.description: Sort field for the search results. Must be either 'created_at' or 'processed_at'.
Sort field for the search results. Must be either 'created_at' or 'processed_at'.

order_by.description: Sort field for the search results. Must be either 'created_at' or 'processed_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort direction for the search results. Must be either ascending or descending.
Sort direction for the search results. Must be either ascending or descending.

order_dir.description: Sort direction for the search results. Must be either ascending or descending.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the role escalation record.

requestor_actor_id.description: Foreign key to customer, if the requestor is a customer. May be null for seller/admin escalations. Refers to shopping_mall_customers.id.

requestor_seller_id.description: Foreign key to seller, if requestor is a seller. Nullable for customer/admin initiated. Refers to shopping_mall_sellers.id.

processed_by_admin_id.description: Admin who processed/escalated this event if applicable. Refers to shopping_mall_admins.id.

target_role.description: Role requested by the escalator (customer, seller, admin, etc.).

status.description: Escalation status (pending, approved, rejected, under_review, revoked, etc.).

reason.description: Notes, justification, or admin comments for this role change request.

created_at.description: Role escalation request creation timestamp.

IShoppingMallRoleEscalation.description:
Records of all privilege/role escalation requests and admin actions for platform actors.

Each record represents a direct request or admin-initiated alteration for increased privileges, e.g., customer-to-seller, seller-to-admin. Stores requestor, target role/status, current processing status, admin/actor attribution, processed result, and action logs for audit. Enables strict privilege boundary enforcement under supervision. Full append-only audit maintained. Used to review, verify, or audit every privilege escalation request or role change attempt on the platform. Vital for administrative review, governance, and compliance.

status.description: Escalation status (pending, approved, rejected, under_review, revoked, etc.). Value to update for this record.

reason.description: Notes, justification, or admin comments for this role change request. Value to update for this record.

processed_by_admin_id.description: Admin who processed/escalated this event. Provide to log the processor of this escalation event.

processed_at.description: Datetime when request was processed/decisioned. Update as part of finalizing the escalation.

IShoppingMallRoleEscalation.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for privilege/role escalation audit records.

This schema is used exclusively by administrative actors to update the status, outcome, reviewer commentary, and processing timestamp for a specific role escalation request within the shopping mall platform. Each update is atomically logged to ensure traceable and compliant privilege boundary modifications, with processor attribution enforced for auditability.

This DTO is leveraged by compliance, governance, and support tools where admin actors must approve, reject, or amend escalation outcomes. It supports enabling a strict audit trail required by business and regulatory standards.

All permitted update fields are optional; only values included in the request are changed—unchanged fields are left intact. Usage pattern includes admin panels, privileged API actors, or automated compliance workflows.

title.description: Filter products by a partial or full match of the product's public name. Allows search within the catalog for products matching the given title substring.

description.description: Filter products by a partial or full match of the product's business description. Can be used for advanced keyword search within product listings.

seller_id.description: Filter products to only those belonging to the specified seller (by unique seller id). Only products owned by this seller will be included in search results.

business_status.description: Filter products by exact workflow status value. Valid values include: draft, published, archived, blocked, pending_approval, and others as defined by business rules.

created_from.description: Filter products created after this UTC timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 date-time format.

created_to.description: Filter products created before this UTC timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_from.description: Filter products updated after this UTC timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_to.description: Filter products updated before this UTC timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 date-time format.

page.description: The current page of the result set for pagination. Must be a positive integer, with 1 meaning the first page.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. Limits available page size to between 1 and 100.

oneOf.description: The field by which sorting will be applied. Valid values: created_at, updated_at, title, default_price.
The field by which sorting will be applied. Valid values: created_at, updated_at, title, default_price.
The field by which sorting will be applied. Valid values: created_at, updated_at, title, default_price.
The field by which sorting will be applied. Valid values: created_at, updated_at, title, default_price.

sort_by.description: The field by which sorting will be applied. Valid values: created_at, updated_at, title, default_price.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction. Must be either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.
Sort order direction. Must be either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

order.description: Sort order direction. Must be either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

IShoppingMallProduct.IRequest.description:
Search/filter request DTO for paginated shopping mall product listings.

This object enables clients, analytics dashboards, and administrative tools to perform flexible, fine-grained retrieval of products in the catalog. Its primary use case is powering complex product discovery flows: public search bars, marketplace filtering, recommendation engines, and internal product curation interfaces.

It supports keyword search, date filtering, ownership (by seller), and workflow status filtering, as well as paginated access and user-specified result ordering for scalability in high-volume environments. All fields are fully optional: queries process only user-supplied filters to maximize API flexibility and ease of client integration.

id.description: Primary key. Universally unique identifier for the product record in the shopping_mall_products table.

title.description: Public product name, shown in catalog and search results. Must be unique per seller. Required for all products.

description.description: Detailed product description. May allow markdown or rich text, intended for buyers to understand product features.

default_price.description: Default display price for this product (may differ from SKU-specific prices). Represents the price shown on main listings and SEO pages.

business_status.description: Current workflow/status for the product. Valid values: draft, published, archived, blocked, pending_approval, etc; the status impacts visibility and editability of the product.

seller.description: Owning seller for this product. This is a summary reference object to the seller identity, providing sufficient display and context information. Replaces the raw foreign key field shopping_mall_seller_id.

primary_categories.description: Array of category summary objects representing the categories this product is directly assigned to for navigation and filtering. Typically kept to the main categories relevant for consumer display/search; may be empty.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp for product creation, automatically set by the system.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp for last modification, updated on every change.

oneOf.description: Soft delete marker; null if active, set to UTC timestamp if deleted.
Null if product is active (not deleted)

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker; null if active, set when product is deleted or archived.

IShoppingMallProduct.description:
Product detail DTO for shopping mall catalog products.

Represents the complete core business structure for a single product as defined by the shopping_mall_products Prisma model. Includes the unique identifier, public name, business description, price, workflow status, seller reference, primary category references, and audit timestamps. The deleted_at field supports soft deletion and moderation workflows. This DTO is used in product detail retrieval, after creation, and after updates.

title.description: Public product name, shown in catalog and search results.

description.description: Detailed product description, with rich text and formatting if allowed by system.

default_price.description: Default display price for product overview (actual purchase price may be per SKU/variant).

business_status.description: Workflow status string; valid values: draft, published, archived, blocked, pending_approval, etc.

IShoppingMallProduct.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new product record in the shopping mall catalog.

This input type collects all business information required to register a top-level product entity in the platform, as represented by the shopping_mall_products database model. The schema enforces essential validation (uniqueness of title per seller, required core fields, and status) based on database and business rules.

Seller identity (shopping_mall_seller_id) is handled by authentication context and NOT accepted directly within this DTO. All audit fields (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) are system-generated and not provided here.

IShoppingMallProduct.IUpdate.description:
Update request DTO for shopping mall product entity.

This object supports updating core mutable business fields for a product in the shopping mall platform. Only the listed fields—title, description, default_price, business_status—are updatable via this DTO; audit, identity, and ownership fields are immutable and excluded. All fields are optional to support partial updates by sellers or admins. Validation constraints are documented on each property, and restricted enum values are enforced for business_status lifecycle changes.

This DTO may only be used by authorized sellers or platform administrators; unauthorized access will be rejected at the API layer. Update behavior is strictly limited to the listed fields—attempts to mutate excluded fields will result in rejection.

title.description:
Public product name, shown in catalog and search results.

Must be unique per seller, required upon creation, and displayed for buyer-facing listing and search. May be updated only by product owner or admin.

description.description:
Detailed product description with optional rich text/markup, supporting full product specification, features, and marketing explanation. Intended for buyer context.

Required on creation; updatable only by authorized users.

default_price.description: Default display price for the catalog product. Must be a non-negative real number, and reflects the public facing price unless SKU-level pricing overrides. Used for listing and business analytics. Currency assumed to be platform-specific default.

oneOf.description:
Workflow/status for product lifecycle. Must be one of: 'draft', 'published', 'archived', 'blocked', 'pending_approval'.

Controls visibility and availability to buyers; update permitted only to valid states and by authorized actors. Business rules and workflow constraints strictly enforced.

Controls visibility and availability to buyers; update permitted only to valid states and by authorized actors. Business rules and workflow constraints strictly enforced.

Controls visibility and availability to buyers; update permitted only to valid states and by authorized actors. Business rules and workflow constraints strictly enforced.

business_status.description:
Workflow/status for product lifecycle. Must be one of: 'draft', 'published', 'archived', 'blocked', 'pending_approval'.

Controls visibility and availability to buyers; update permitted only to valid states and by authorized actors. Business rules and workflow constraints strictly enforced.

IShoppingMallProductSku.IRequest.description:
Search query parameters and filters for listing SKUs related to a single product in the catalog, commonly used for advanced SKU search, inventory dashboards, or product management tools.

Allows filtering by SKU status, price range, stock range, or by SKU code substring and supports pagination. SKU status is a required filter in many dashboard flows. Applies only in the context of a single parent product (not global SKU search).

Pagination and sorting fields must be implemented by the backend as per platform API standards.

status.description: Workflow status to filter SKUs (e.g., 'active', 'out_of_stock', 'archived', 'draft'). Optional – if omitted, returns all statuses.

sku_code.description: Substring, wildcard, or full match of the SKU's code for partial search (case-insensitive), e.g., to find all SKUs with 'XL' in the code. Optional.

min_price.description: Minimum price to filter SKUs by, inclusive. Optional.

max_price.description: Maximum price to filter SKUs by, inclusive. Optional.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (1-based index). Optional, default is 1.

limit.description: Result page size, controls number of SKUs per page. Optional, default is 20.

sort_by.description: Field by which to sort results (e.g., 'created_at', 'sku_code', 'status', 'price', 'stock'). Optional.

oneOf.description: Sort order for the results: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Optional.
Sort order for the results: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Optional.

order.description: Sort order for the results: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Optional.

IShoppingMallProductSku.description:
Individual SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for a specific variant or option of a catalog product.

Each SKU represents a unique variant of a product (e.g., color, size, option combinations), with independent inventory, price, and status. SKUs are linked to the parent product and to their attribute values (via subsidiary tables). Inventory, per-SKU pricing, out-of-stock flags, and barcode/business reference codes are managed here. SKUs are included in product-level search and filtering APIs.

Audit, status, and soft delete fields support traceability, operation, and moderation workflows.

The parent product is referenced as a summary object for rich context in the API, replacing the primitive product_id FK and preventing N+1 queries or loss of parent context. This avoids client-side cross-reference lookups; the productId is present in API paths.

id.description:
Primary key.

Unique identifier for the SKU record in the shopping mall system. This UUID distinguishes each SKU variant and is referenced in API operations as the skuId parameter. It is auto-generated by the system and is immutable throughout the SKU lifecycle.

product.description:
Reference to parent catalog product (summary object).

Provides contextual details about the owning product of this SKU. Ensures API clients have the relevant product title, code, or other display metadata alongside the SKU, and eliminates N+1 cross-lookups. The productId is present in the endpoint path (not in schema), avoiding redundancy.

sku_code.description:
Unique business SKU/barcode identifier within a product scope.

The SKU code serves as the business-facing identifier for variant management, barcode scanning, inventory handling, and search. Must be unique per product (see unique index on [shopping_mall_product_id, sku_code]). Cannot be empty or duplicated for the same product.

price.description:
Sale price for this variant (overrides product default price if present).

This field defines the transactional sale price for orders referencing the SKU. Must be a non-negative value. Supports discounts/special pricing logic at the SKU level. Used in all inventory, checkout, and reporting flows.

stock.description:
Inventory units available for this SKU.

Stock represents the real-time available quantity for this product variant. Affects add-to-cart, purchase, and order fulfillment eligibility. Zero indicates out-of-stock; negative values are not permitted.

status.description:
Workflow status for SKU (e.g., active, out_of_stock, archived, draft).

Controls catalog visibility and operational state. Only 'active' SKUs are available for sale. 'archived' and 'draft' statuses are used for moderation, setup, or soft deletion. Business logic enforces transitions between these states.

created_at.description:
UTC timestamp for SKU creation.

Indicates when the SKU variant was first registered in the system. Used for auditing, reporting, and user-facing display of new inventory.

updated_at.description:
UTC timestamp for last SKU change.

Tracks the most recent update to any core SKU business or inventory field. Useful for tracking inventory adjustments and status changes across the product lifecycle.

deleted_at.description:
Soft delete flag: null if active, set when archived/deleted.

When this field is null, the SKU is considered active in catalog and operations. When set to a UTC timestamp, the SKU is archived or deleted (soft delete pattern); not returned in product/SKU listings by default.

sku_code.description:
Unique business SKU/barcode identifier within a product scope.

Must be unique per product. This is used for both business operations (barcode scanning, warehouse handling) and end-user search/disambiguation. Cannot be empty or duplicated for same-product SKUs.

price.description:
Sale price for this variant (overrides product default price if present).

Must be a non-negative value representing the sale price for this SKU. Required for checkout and transactional operations.

stock.description:
Inventory units available for this SKU.

Non-negative integer determining stock count at SKU registration. A value of zero means the SKU starts as out-of-stock. Cannot be negative.

status.description:
Workflow status for SKU (e.g., active, out_of_stock, archived, draft).

Initial status assigned at creation. Only 'active' SKUs are orderable. Business logic validates allowed values and transitions.

IShoppingMallProductSku.ICreate.description:
All details for the SKU to be created, including code, price, inventory, and status.

Used when a seller registers a new SKU variant under an existing product. Links the SKU to its parent product by the productId path parameter, not in the request body. Enforces business rules for SKU uniqueness, pricing validity, and inventory initialization. System-managed fields (id, timestamps, deleted_at, and product reference) are omitted—populated server-side.

IShoppingMallProductSku.IUpdate.description:
SKU update request for a specific catalog product variant in the shopping mall system.

Used to update an existing SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) variant identified by both product and SKU ID. Enables modifications to SKU code, sale price, inventory, or status. Business logic ensures all fields are validated, ownership and product linkage is enforced, and audit trails are updated.

Only the seller who owns the product may perform updates; SKU/product existence and active state are checked prior to modification. Some fields are optional—see business logic for required/optional field rules. All changes must comply with the validation constraints described in the schema.

sku_code.description: Unique business SKU/barcode identifier for this variant (must be unique within the parent product's scope). Used for external reference, warehouse, or POS system integration.

price.description: Optional: Sale price for this variant (overrides product default price if set). Must be a non-negative value representing the final sale price for this SKU. Leave unchanged if not updated.

stock.description: Optional: Inventory units available for this SKU. Must be a non-negative integer. Null or omitted means leave stock unchanged.

status.description: Optional: Workflow status for SKU (e.g., active, out_of_stock, archived, draft). Must be a valid status recognized by business logic.

IShoppingMallProductImage.IRequest.description:
Query/filter DTO for searching and paginating images/media associated with products or SKUs. Used for both product-level and SKU-specific image searches.

Clients may supply filter parameters such as display position, alt text, label, and search keywords. Pagination and sorting controls allow for efficient retrieval in large galleries. Additional business-level filters (e.g., only active images) may be supported by the endpoint implementation.

cdn_uri.description: Optional: Query by exact CDN or public URI of the image file. Used to locate a specific image asset when the URI is known.

alt_text.description: Optional: Query/filter by image accessibility text content (for search or moderation). Allows users to search images based on alt text content. Typically supports partial match or full text index.

label.description: Optional: Query/filter by business label attached to the image asset (used for internal categorization or asset management).

position.description: Optional: Query/filter for the display position/order in the product/SKU carousel/gallery. Lower values are prioritized on display.

page.description: Pagination: 1-based page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Pagination: Maximum number of image items to retrieve per page. Defaults to 20 if omitted. Max 100.

oneOf.description: Sort field for returned images (supports: position, created_at, label). Defaults to position.
Sort field for returned images (supports: position, created_at, label). Defaults to position.
Sort field for returned images (supports: position, created_at, label). Defaults to position.

sort_by.description: Sort field for returned images (supports: position, created_at, label). Defaults to position.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc). Defaults to ascending.
Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc). Defaults to ascending.

sort_order.description: Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc). Defaults to ascending.

search.description: Free-text search filter applied to alt_text, label, or other context fields. Supports partial or fuzzy matching as defined in backend implementation.

id.description: Primary key for the product image asset. Unique identifier for each image/media record associated with a product or SKU in the digital asset management table.

oneOf.description: Foreign key referencing the product that this image is associated with. Only one of shopping_mall_product_id or shopping_mall_product_sku_id should be set. Null if this image is SKU-specific.
Null if this image is SKU-specific.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Foreign key referencing the product that this image is associated with. Only one of shopping_mall_product_id or shopping_mall_product_sku_id should be set. Null if this image is SKU-specific.

oneOf.description: Foreign key referencing the SKU variant that this image is associated with. Only one of shopping_mall_product_id or shopping_mall_product_sku_id should be set. Null if this image is product-level.
Null if this image is at the product level.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: Foreign key referencing the SKU variant that this image is associated with. Only one of shopping_mall_product_id or shopping_mall_product_sku_id should be set. Null if this image is at the product level.

cdn_uri.description: CDN or publicly accessible URI for the image media. Used by clients to render the asset. Must be unique for each image in the table.

oneOf.description: Accessibility alternative text shown if the image fails to load. Can be used for screen readers and compliance.
Can be null if no alt text is provided for the image.

alt_text.description: Optional alt text for accessibility compliance. Present to support screen readers and fallback display when the image cannot be loaded. Can be null if not provided.

position.description: Display order of the image for galleries, carousels, or main/secondary image selection. Lower values are displayed first. Must be unique within the product or SKU context.

oneOf.description: Internal business/management label to aid in catalog or digital asset organization. Not shown to customers.
Can be null if no label is assigned.

label.description: Internal management or business-use label for the image asset. Intended for platform operators or catalog managers. Not shown to end-users. Can be null.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp recording when the asset was first created in the database.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp automatically updated on each asset update, for audit or tracking.

oneOf.description: Datetime if the asset has been soft deleted (archived/removed from catalog without being permanently deleted).
Null if active and not deleted.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker. If null, the image is active and visible in the catalog; if datetime, the image has been soft deleted or retired.

IShoppingMallProductImage.description:
Product or SKU image/media asset record as defined in shopping_mall_product_images table.

Represents a single image or digital asset attached to a catalog product or a specific SKU variant. Images may be associated at the product level (shopping_mall_product_id) for general display, or at the SKU level (shopping_mall_product_sku_id) for variant-specific presentation. Auditing, ordering, soft deletion and business management are supported via dedicated fields.

Used for displaying product galleries, variant images, and administrating catalog media assets. Only one association—either product or SKU—is valid at a time. Audit and deletion fields track media asset lifecycle and moderation history.

cdn_uri.description: CDN or publicly accessible URI for the image media. This must be the pre-uploaded file location (see business flow), and is required for all image asset creation.

oneOf.description: Accessibility or alternative text for screen readers or image load failure.
Null if no alt text is provided.

alt_text.description: Optional alternative text for accessibility. May be set to null if not provided.

position.description: Position/order for display in galleries/carousels. Lower numbers come first. Must be unique within the associated product or SKU context.

oneOf.description: Optional management or administrative label for internally classifying the image asset.
Null if not used.

label.description: Optional internal business label for catalog/image administration. Not shown to end users. May be null.

oneOf.description: Product ID to which the image is attached. Required if creating product-level image. May not be set if associating with SKU.
Null if creating a SKU-level image.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Product ID to attach the image to (for product-level images). One of shopping_mall_product_id or shopping_mall_product_sku_id MUST be set, never both. Business logic enforces this required relationship.

oneOf.description: SKU ID to which the image is attached. Required if creating SKU-level image. May not be set if associating with product.
Null if creating a product-level image.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: SKU ID to attach the image to (for SKU-level images). One of shopping_mall_product_id or shopping_mall_product_sku_id MUST be set, never both. Null for product-level images. Enforced by business logic.

IShoppingMallProductImage.ICreate.description:
Request DTO to create an image asset in the shopping_mall_product_images table.

Used for uploading new product or SKU-associated images. The provided CDN URI must point to a valid, pre-uploaded asset, and the asset must be associated with either a product or a SKU exclusively (never both at once). Alt text, display position, and internal label are optional but recommended. Audit and deletion fields are not present and are handled by the backend lifecycle.

This DTO enables both product-level and SKU-specific asset creation, supporting gallery and variant image management for the platform catalog.

IShoppingMallProductImage.IUpdate.description: Update DTO: Allows partial updates of position, alt_text, or label for a product or SKU image. Protected fields (product association, SKU association, media URI, audit fields, and deletion marker) are immutable. Follows business logic and access restrictions per shopping_mall_product_images table and API operation.

position.description: Image display position ordering for carousels or galleries. Lower values are shown first. Updates validate unique positions among all images of the product/SKU. Must be positive integer if provided.

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility or text alternative for the image. Can be set to null to clear. Improves accessibility and displays on load/error failure. Editable by sellers for compliance.

label.description: Optional internal system/business management label, not shown to end users. Used for back-office tagging, workflow, or audits. May be cleared by setting null.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.IRequest.description: Request DTO: Encapsulates search and pagination criteria for retrieving attribute definitions for a specific shopping mall product. Used in admin and seller-facing tools for robust attribute management. All parameters are optional except for required pagination controls (page/limit).

search.description: Query filter string for searching by attribute name. May be a substring or complete value. Supports null/empty for no filtering.

position.description: Optional filter on display order position value. Enables retrieving only attributes at a given hierarchical UI position. Null for no filter.

page.description: Page number for paginated attribute results. Defaults to 1 if not provided. Must be positive integer.

limit.description: Maximum results per page for attribute search. Defaults enforced by business logic, typically 10/20/50. Must be positive integer; limited to system maximum.

sort.description: Optional sort order. Allows sorting by display position or attribute name. Enum or free text depending on system config.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.description:
Logical attribute definition for a specific product in the shopping mall catalog. 

Represents attribute types (such as color, size, material, or custom option names) that can be used to define product-level SKU variants. Each attribute belongs to exactly one product and is used in conjunction with other variant options for catalog and SKU construction.

Provides metadata such as a logical name, display position for the UI picker, and includes audit fields for traceability (creation, update, soft-delete timestamp). Attributes are uniquely named per product and must be managed in accordance with SKU and attribute value mapping logic.

id.description: Primary key. Unique UUID identifier for the product attribute.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Unique UUID of the parent product to which this attribute belongs. References shopping_mall_products.id.

attribute_name.description: Logical name for this attribute (e.g., color, size, material, custom option labels) as shown to buyers and sellers. Must be unique within the parent product context.

position.description: Display order for this attribute within a product. Lower values are shown first in the UI variant picker.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the attribute definition was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last update to this attribute definition.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker for this attribute definition. Null if active; otherwise set to a timestamp for deletion.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.ICreate.description:
DTO for creating a new logical attribute for a specific product in the catalog, as used for SKU variant definition.

Specifies the necessary data to define a product attribute: a logical name (such as color, size, or custom option), and the intended display order (position) for the attribute in UI pickers. The associated product is determined by the productId path parameter, not included in the body. Audit fields and system-managed identifiers are excluded.

Attribute name must be unique within the scope of the parent product and conform to allowed naming conventions for user-facing option labels.

attribute_name.description: Logical name for this attribute (e.g., color, size, material, custom option labels) as shown to buyers and sellers. Must be unique within the parent product context.

position.description: Display order for this attribute within a product. Lower values are shown first in the UI variant picker.

attribute_name.description: Logical name for this attribute (e.g., Color, Size). Visible in the product variant picker user interface. Must be unique for the given product ID. Updates must comply with platform business rules – allow descriptive naming, prohibit reserved or inappropriate terms per platform policy, and enforce length/content validation. Changing to a name already used by another attribute under the same product will be blocked.

position.description: Display order for the attribute within the UI when selecting variants. Lower numbered positions are presented first. This determines sequential presentation of attributes (such as Color-Size-Material). Updates must remain within the attribute list bounds for the product. Typical values are integer indices >= 0.

oneOf.description: Soft delete marker ISO datetime string if attribute is to be removed. Set by the system for attribute removal. If null or omitted, attribute remains active.
No removal (attribute remains active, not deleted).

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker: null if attribute remains active, or set to UTC datetime string to request attribute removal (soft delete).

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.IUpdate.description:
Update object for shopping mall product attribute. Represents updatable fields for an attribute record (e.g., name, position, or marking for soft deletion).

The object maps to the shopping_mall_product_attributes table and is used in attribute update operations (for both seller and admin APIs). Only fields directly modifiable by the client are exposed; parent foreign key values come from the path (not body). Edited attributes must comply with uniqueness (attribute_name per product); validation and business rules are enforced at the API logic and database constraint layers.

Soft deletion is triggered by providing a non-null ISO datetime value for deleted_at – typically managed by the backend upon attribute removal scenarios.

attribute_id.description: Optional filter to retrieve only attribute values matching the specific attribute ID for the SKU. When provided, restricts the search to values assigned to this attribute under the given SKU.

value_display_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to attribute values whose human-readable label matches or contains the provided substring. Used for search/autocomplete features or narrowing value results in SKU edit UIs.

page.description: Page number for paginated queries (1-based index). Defaults to 1 if omitted. Used to fetch results in sequential pages when the result set is large.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive. Used to control result set size and optimize pagination/performance; defaults are platform-defined.

IShoppingMallProductAttributeValue.IRequ.description:
Search and filter object type for paginated search of product SKU attribute values (variant option values) in shopping malls.

Provides filtering by specific attribute, value display name, and typical pagination controls (page, limit). Used in PATCH /shoppingMall/seller/skus/{skuId}/attributeValues and related admin endpoints as request body. Allows advanced catalog management workflows (showing all attribute values assigned to a SKU, filtering variant options by name/attribute, supporting frontend list rendering for SKU editing UIs).

id.description: Primary key for the attribute value assignment to a SKU. Uniquely identifies a specific mapping between a SKU and a product attribute.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: Identifier of the product SKU for which the attribute value is defined. References shopping_mall_product_skus.id.

shopping_mall_product_attribute_id.description: Identifier of the attribute type (e.g., Color, Size, Material) whose value is represented. References shopping_mall_product_attributes.id.

value_display_name.description: Human-readable label showing the value for this attribute (e.g., 'Red', 'XL', 'Matte'). Used for variant selection, filters, and customer-facing displays.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp for when this SKU/attribute value mapping was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp for the last update of the value mapping.

IShoppingMallProductAttributeValue.description:
Represents the mapping of a product attribute value (such as Color: Red or Size: XL) to a specific SKU in the product catalog.

Used to define all allowed variant combinations for catalog SKUs by linking an attribute (type) and its value to an individual SKU. Enables dynamic variant selection, filtering, and display of product options, as well as comprehensive audit and traceability through associated timestamps and foreign keys.

Business rules: Ensures each SKU can only have one value assigned per attribute (enforced by unique (sku, attribute) pair constraint). Supports management of variant option details in both customer and seller/admin flows.

shopping_mall_product_attribute_id.description: The attribute type (e.g., Color, Size, Material) whose value should be set for this SKU. Must point to a valid attribute defined in shopping_mall_product_attributes.

value_display_name.description: Human-facing label of the attribute value assigned to this SKU (e.g., 'Red', 'L', 'Matte'). Required. Must be unique for the same SKU/attribute pair and reflect an allowed value for this attribute type.

IShoppingMallProductAttributeValue.ICrea.description:
Payload for assigning a new attribute value to a product SKU in the catalog (e.g., adding 'Color: Blue' to a T-shirt variant for a specific SKU).

Includes the attribute reference and the specific value label for the variant configuration. Enforced to avoid duplicate attributes for any single SKU and for validation of allowed attribute types in the catalog context. Used in scenarios allowing sellers or admins to enrich the variant matrix for product offerings.

value_display_name.description: Renderable text for value (e.g., 'Red', 'XL', 'Matte'). Display name for the attribute value. Used in product option selection, filtering, and product SKU variant display interfaces.

shopping_mall_product_attribute_id.description: Corresponding attribute type for this value. References shopping_mall_product_attributes.id. Required if reassigning this attribute value to a different attribute (e.g., switching from 'color' to 'size').

IShoppingMallProductAttributeValue.IUpda.description:
DTO for updating a product SKU attribute value mapping in the catalog. All fields are optional for PATCH-style flexibility; sellers/admins may update only the label (display name) or reassign to a different attribute.

Business rules ensure the combination of SKU and attribute remains unique after any reassignment. Used by both seller and admin update endpoints.

customer_id.description: Optionally filter results by customer UUID. Only available for admin queries; not exposed in customer endpoints.

created_from.description: Return only carts created at or after this UTC ISO timestamp.

created_to.description: Return only carts created before this UTC ISO timestamp.

updated_from.description: Return only carts with updated_at at or after this UTC ISO timestamp.

updated_to.description: Return only carts with updated_at before this UTC ISO timestamp.

page.description: Pagination - page number (1-based). Defaults typically to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Pagination - max items per page. Administrative endpoints may support larger values; customer endpoints typically restrict to smaller limits.

oneOf.description: Sorting field. Allowed values are 'created_at' or 'updated_at'.
Sorting field. Allowed values are 'created_at' or 'updated_at'.

sort_by.description: Sorting field. Allowed values are 'created_at' or 'updated_at'.

oneOf.description: Sorting direction. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not specified.
Sorting direction. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not specified.

sort_order.description: Sorting direction. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not specified.

IShoppingMallCart.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, and pagination parameters for administrative shopping mall cart queries. Allows admin dashboards to retrieve platform-wide carts matching various filters, sortable by creation or last update time, and paginated as needed.

Not available for customers — intended only for platform administrative audit endpoints.

IShoppingMallCart.description:
Customer shopping cart root entity.

Represents the persistent, per-customer container for shopping activity within the e-commerce platform.
