Each cart is uniquely associated with one authenticated customer and holds all relevant metadata required for managing and auditing shopping intent, inventory reservation, and shopping flows. The cart entity enforces the business rule that only one active cart exists per customer, preventing duplication and ensuring data consistency.

Carts support all add-to-cart, checkout, inventory validation, and customer intent tracking within the platform. Deletion or conversion to an order removes the cart record, keeping the domain model lean and auditable. Timestamps allow system operators and support staff to debug, monitor cart activity, and resolve customer service requests.

id.description: Primary key for the shopping cart entity. Globally unique identifier assigned upon creation.

customer.description: Linked customer (cart owner). Contains only summary info for display and analytic embedding. References {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the cart was created. Adheres to ISO 8601 standards. Used for lifecycle, auditing, and business event correlation.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the cart state. Adheres to ISO 8601 standards. Updated by any business event impacting the cart.

IShoppingMallCart.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new shopping cart associated with an authenticated customer.

No client-side properties are required as customer ownership and all required metadata are set by server logic using authentication context. The DTO must exist for API contract completeness and documentation, but contains no user-supplied input fields. Any attempt to add properties is strictly rejected to enforce business logic and data integrity.

IShoppingMallCart.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema for updating a customer's shopping cart.

Represents modifiable properties for an existing cart entity, as used by authenticated customers or privileged admin/support roles.

Only fields explicitly allowed by platform business rules and schema constraints are present. Ownership and foreign key fields are restricted to platform-controlled flows. Timestamp properties may be used for client-side cache refresh or synchronization, under audit logging.

All update operations are subject to strong integrity and audit requirements.

updated_at.description: Last updated timestamp for cart state. Used to indicate when the cart was most recently changed (e.g., add/remove item, checkout event, etc.). May be updated to perform optimistic locking or for API cache refresh. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IRequest.description:
Request body schema for querying and paginating shopping cart items.

Encapsulates allowed filter parameters, pagination controls, and sorting rules for cart item search within a specific cartId context.

Used by shopping cart item listing operation, supporting filter by SKU, by quantity ranges, by recently-updated status, and more. Implements business validation around inventory, uniqueness, and cart constraints on query.

This DTO does not define business-side update or create of cart records (see IShoppingMallCart.IUpdate and related types for those use cases).

sku_id.description: Filter items to a specific product SKU, if specified. Must be a valid UUID corresponding to a SKU in shopping_mall_product_skus.

min_quantity.description: Filter for cart items with quantity greater than or equal to this value. Used for finding bulk purchase or inventory edge cases.

max_quantity.description: Filter for cart items with quantity less than or equal to this value. Sets an upper bound for quantity-based queries.

page.description: Page number to return (1-based index for paginated queries). Must be positive. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Minimum 1, maximum 100. Defaults to 20 if omitted.

oneOf.description: Sort field for cart item listing. One of: created_at, updated_at, quantity.
Sort field for cart item listing. One of: created_at, updated_at, quantity.
Sort field for cart item listing. One of: created_at, updated_at, quantity.

sort_by.description: Sort field for cart item listing. One of: created_at, updated_at, quantity.

oneOf.description: Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.
Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.

id.description: Unique identifier for the cart item. Primary key in the shopping_mall_cart_items table.

shopping_mall_cart_id.description: Parent cart reference. Uniquely identifies the cart that this item belongs to. Foreign key to shopping_mall_carts.id.

quantity.description: Desired quantity for this SKU in the cart. Must be positive and less than or equal to SKU's available inventory.

created_at.description: Cart item creation timestamp. Indicates when the item was first added to the cart.

updated_at.description: Last modified timestamp for the cart item. Indicates when the quantity or SKU association was most recently changed.

productSku.description: Detailed summary of the SKU referenced by this cart item. Includes product information, price, and variant/options context.

IShoppingMallCartItem.description:
Individual item record within a shopping cart.

Represents a single SKU/variant entry for a specific product in a customer's cart, including desired quantity and SKU reference. Each cart item is uniquely associated with its cart and a specific product SKU. Quantity reflects user purchasing intent and is validated against inventory on add/update.

Cart items are always managed as part of their cart lifecycle. Security policies restrict cart item manipulation to authenticated cart owners.

Relations:
- Belongs to: shopping_mall_carts
- References: shopping_mall_product_skus (SKU details in productSku)
- Composite unique index: (shopping_mall_cart_id, shopping_mall_product_sku_id)

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: Target SKU to add to the cart. Foreign key referencing shopping_mall_product_skus.id.

quantity.description: Desired quantity for the new cart item. Must be a positive integer, not exceeding the SKU's available stock.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for adding a new cart item (SKU/variant) to a user's shopping cart.

Specifies the product SKU to add (variant/option) and the desired quantity. SKU must exist and be available for sale. Quantity must respect available stock. If an item for this SKU already exists in the cart, update operation is required instead.

Security: Actor must be an authenticated customer. Cart ownership and SKU validity are enforced server-side.

Relations:
- References: shopping_mall_product_skus (specified by shopping_mall_product_sku_id).
- Parent cart context is provided by the path parameter (do not include cart ID in request body).

IShoppingMallProductSku.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for product SKU entities.

Represents a minimal, display-optimized view of a stock keeping unit (SKU) under a catalog product. Used for reference in relations such as wishlists, cart items, or order items. May omit or abbreviate attributes for efficiency, displaying only primary context like SKU code, product title, variant summary, and current availability.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SKU.

code.description: SKU code, unique within its parent product.

product_title.description: Human-readable catalog title of the parent product.

option_summary.description: Concise description of the SKU variants/options (e.g., color, size).

in_stock.description: Indicates whether this SKU is currently available for purchase.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for a shopping cart item, used to modify the properties of an existing cart item within a specific cart. Its main function is to update the quantity of a SKU in the cart, subject to inventory constraints and business rules.

This type does not allow modification of the SKU or cart associations—only the desired quantity can be altered. The DTO enforces cart integrity by requiring that the updated quantity be a positive integer, not exceeding inventory levels. If the quantity is set to 0, clients must issue a DELETE request instead of calling this endpoint.

This structure aligns with the update operation on shopping_mall_cart_items and omits ownership or path-identifying fields (cartId, itemId) as these are provided via API path parameters and auth context. System-managed fields (created_at, updated_at) and identity fields are excluded as per security-first schema practices.

quantity.description: Desired quantity for this SKU in the cart. Must be a positive integer, greater than zero, and not exceed available inventory as enforced by business rules and stock checks. Setting quantity to 0 is disallowed for update; use DELETE instead.

IShoppingMallWishlist.IRequest.description:
DTO for requesting a filtered and paginated list of wishlists from the shopping mall platform for admin/reporting use cases. Enables advanced searching for wishlists based on customer ID, creation date, or sorting options.

This type includes standard pagination, search, and filtering fields to allow the admin to find and analyze customer wishlists. Both broad and narrow queries are supported. May be extended with additional filter fields as required by analytic or audit features.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting from 1. Used for navigation through result sets.

limit.description: Maximum number of wishlists to return per page. Supports system-configurable maximum for performance considerations.

customer_id.description: Optional filter for a specific customer's wishlist. When set, restricts results to the wishlist belonging to this customer.

created_from.description: Optional start date (inclusive) filter for wishlists created on or after this timestamp, in ISO 8601 date-time format.

created_to.description: Optional end date (inclusive) filter for wishlists created on or before this timestamp, in ISO 8601 date-time format.

oneOf.description: Field by which results should be sorted. Supported values are 'created_at' for creation date and 'updated_at' for last modified date.
Field by which results should be sorted. Supported values are 'created_at' for creation date and 'updated_at' for last modified date.

sort_by.description: Field by which results should be sorted. Supported values are 'created_at' for creation date and 'updated_at' for last modified date.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction—ascending or descending. Supported values are 'asc' and 'desc'.
Sort order direction—ascending or descending. Supported values are 'asc' and 'desc'.

sort_order.description: Sort order direction—ascending or descending. Supported values are 'asc' and 'desc'.

IShoppingMallWishlist.description:
Customer wishlist root entity for persistent product interest.

Each wishlist is owned by a single customer and contains items representing SKUs the customer is interested in but does not intend to purchase immediately. Each customer has at most one wishlist. Wishlists persist through account sessions and device changes, helping customers track and later revisit interesting products. Items in the wishlist are managed as subsidiary records.

The association to the owning customer is represented as a reference object (customer: IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary), following API best practices for foreign key relations. The raw UUID foreign key field is replaced in the response DTO and all association contexts.

id.description: Primary key identifying the wishlist entity in the shopping_mall_wishlists table.

customer.description:
Owning customer of the wishlist as a structured reference object (association).

This association replaces the raw 'shopping_mall_customer_id' foreign key and gives full customer reference context. Only the ID and summary fields for the customer are included here. One-to-one association enforced both in schema and in API contract.

created_at.description: Wishlist creation timestamp. Indicates when the wishlist was originally created.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for the wishlist. Reflects the most recent modification to the wishlist or its metadata.

IShoppingMallWishlist.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new shopping mall customer wishlist.

Ownership is determined by the authenticated customer context (from JWT) and must not be supplied in the request body. No fields are required in this DTO as the creation is implicit and requires no additional input.

updated_at.description:
Last update timestamp for the wishlist.

This should reflect the most recent time the wishlist was modified. Used for concurrency control or client-side updates.
Corresponds to `updated_at` in Prisma schema.

IShoppingMallWishlist.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for customer wishlists in the shopping mall platform.

Allows modification of eligible wishlist metadata only (e.g., timestamps or comment fields). Ownership of the wishlist and item lists cannot be changed via this DTO—such changes are managed separately. Only the wishlist's owner (authenticated customer) may update their own wishlist. Modification is limited by business rules ensuring no changes to subsidiary entity structures or cross-customer data leaks.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). The system treats values less than 1 as 1. Used to fetch the subset of wishlist items for a given client view.

limit.description: Number of items returned per page of wishlist item results. Maximum capped at 100 to control load and support fast response times.

search.description: Optional search keyword to filter wishlist items by product name, SKU, or category. Empty string or null disables filtering. Case insensitive.

oneOf.description: Field to sort wishlist items by. Allowed values: 'created_at', 'product_name', 'sku'. Default is 'created_at'.
Field to sort wishlist items by. Allowed values: 'created_at', 'product_name', 'sku'. Default is 'created_at'.
Field to sort wishlist items by. Allowed values: 'created_at', 'product_name', 'sku'. Default is 'created_at'.

sort_by.description: Field to sort wishlist items by. Allowed values: 'created_at', 'product_name', 'sku'. Default is 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction for search results. Allowed values: 'asc', 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.
Sort order direction for search results. Allowed values: 'asc', 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.

order.description: Sort order direction for search results. Allowed values: 'asc', 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.IRequest.description:
Query and search parameters for retrieving (paginated/filterable) items from a customer's wishlist.

Supports pagination, keyword search, and sorting options for usability at scale. Common use is for wishlists with many saved SKUs to enable fast retrieval and for presenting a manageable UI. Security requires only the wishlist's owner (authenticated customer) or platform admins may use this operation.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.description:
Represents a single wishlist item within a specified customer wishlist, with all relations transformed for API consumption.

This DTO is used in detailed item retrieval responses (GET /shoppingMall/customer/wishlists/{wishlistId}/items/{itemId}) and exposes context-rich entity references instead of raw foreign keys.

- The referenced product SKU is expressed as a summary object (IShoppingMallProductSku.ISummary), not a raw ID, ensuring complete context without extra API requests.
- Optionally surfaces parent wishlist as IShoppingMallWishlist.ISummary for full independence in alternative views.

No duplicate SKUs are allowed within the same wishlist (DB-level composite unique constraint). Ownership is always resolved through the parent wishlist contextual reference, not directly via actor FK.

Used in response bodies for retrieving detailed wishlist item information, supporting individual item management and display in various wishlist UIs.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for this wishlist item.

productSku.description: The referenced product SKU for this wishlist item. Summary object provides product details for display with minimal N+1 queries.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp representing when this item was added to the wishlist.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new wishlist item linked to an existing customer wishlist.

Specifies the product SKU to be saved (referenced by SKU ID). The parent wishlist context is provided by the endpoint path and must match the authenticated customer. No duplicate SKUs are permitted within one wishlist, enforced by a composite unique constraint in the database. The client only specifies the SKU; all other ownership and timestamp fields are set by the system.

Used as the payload for POST requests to add a new wishlist item for a customer.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: The product SKU to add as an item in the wishlist. Must reference a valid SKU not already present in the wishlist.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for individual wishlist items attached to a customer's wishlist.

This type allows modification of properties of a single wishlist item such as the referenced product SKU. Field updatability is strictly business-rule-governed and limited in practice—typically only SKU or related metadata, if even allowed. Used in the request body for updating a wishlist item identified by both the wishlist ID and item ID path parameters. No properties corresponding to ownership/authentication or compositional links (parent, actors) are included—these are enforced by the authentication and path context, never passed from the client.

Validations:
- Do NOT include wishlist or actor IDs (obtained from path/auth context)
- Do NOT include item ID (provided in path)
- Only allow updatable fields according to business policy and schema definition
- SKU reference must point to a valid, non-duplicated SKU within the wishlist (enforce uniqueness)
- No system-managed fields (created_at etc.) may be updated
- Use only fields explicitly defined in the Prisma schema for updatability.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: New SKU UUID for this wishlist item. Optional if product SKU may be updated, always validated for existence and duplication in parent wishlist. Only supply if performing a SKU change. Must not duplicate an existing item in the same wishlist.

IShoppingMallOrder.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, and pagination DTO for querying shopping mall orders in bulk for management dashboards, analytics, or customer support.

Allows clients to specify multiple criteria to search or filter primary order records. Covers all fields in the main order entity, with support for partial text matching (order_number), customer and seller reference-based filtering, order status(s), and time-based retrieval windows. Includes paging and sort controls as is typical in management/analytics contexts.

Notes:
- All parameters are optional and combinable
- Accepts page and limit for paginated navigation
- Supports dynamic filtering for flexible business queries
- All input is validated for type and sanity before query execution

order_number.description: Order number (platform business key) to filter/search by partial or exact match. Example: ORD202500001

customer_id.description: Filter orders by purchasing customer UUID

seller_id.description: Filter orders by main responsible seller UUID

status.description: Order statuses (comma-separated or repeatable) to filter; e.g., paid, cancelled, delivered

from_date.description: Start datetime (inclusive) in the platform's timezone for creation-date-based filtering

to_date.description: End datetime (inclusive) in the platform's timezone for creation-date-based filtering

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based index, default 1)

limit.description: Page size (number of records per page, default 20, max 100)

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g., created_at, order_number, status). Safe sort options enforced by backend.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: asc (ascending) or desc (descending). Default desc.
Sort direction: asc (ascending) or desc (descending). Default desc.

order.description: Sort direction: asc (ascending) or desc (descending). Default desc.

id.description: Primary key of the order record as generated by the system. Used internally as the unique identifier for the order entity.

order_number.description: Business-unique order number for external referencing and customer support. Unique across the platform. Example: ORD202500001

status.description: Current platform order status (such as pending, paid, cancelled, shipped, delivered, refunded).

total_amount.description: Final total monetary value of the order including all items, taxes, shipping, and discounts.

currency.description: Currency code (ISO 4217 standard, e.g., USD, KRW) for the order's final total.

created_at.description: Order creation timestamp (system-generated).

updated_at.description: Latest modification timestamp for the order (system-managed and audit trailed).

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion status; null if order is active.

customer.description: Customer who placed the order. Detailed in customer summary object.

address.description: Shipping delivery address tied to the order, as a summary object.

seller.description: Seller primarily responsible for this order, exposed as summary object.

items_count.description: Total number of individual items/lines in this order.

shipments_count.description: Number of shipments associated with this order, supporting split-shipment scenarios.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Represents a full order record in the shopping mall platform, capturing all top-level details about a single customer purchase. Includes audit and relationship fields per the shopping_mall_orders DB schema.

Anchors relationships to customer, address, seller, plus counts for children items and shipments. Delivers all metadata required for order management, compliance, and financial tracking. Every order must have a unique business order number, status, and references to the core actors and transactional context.

System fields provide audit trail, with deleted_at supporting soft deletes as needed by business. Summary objects for customer, seller, and address are referenced for full context in single call. All values, relationships, and timestamps adhere strictly to the platform's high-level commerce requirements.

order_number.description: Unique business order number provided for new order. Must match pattern and be globally unique in the system.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: UUID for the customer placing the order. Must refer to an existing and eligible customer entity.

shopping_mall_address_id.description: UUID for the delivery address associated with this order. Must refer to a valid, active address record.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Main seller responsible for this order (single-seller context). UUID must refer to an enabled seller entity.

status.description: Initial order status (pending, paid, etc) as dictated by business logic.

total_amount.description: Total transaction value, matching sum of items, shipping, and discounts if applicable.

currency.description: Currency code (ISO 4217, e.g., USD, KRW) in which this order is valued.

IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.description:
Request structure required to create a new shopping mall order. All references (customer, address, seller) are set by UUID to ensure referential integrity. 

Order_number must be globally unique. Status and currency must be valid per business and database rules. No system fields (id, created_at, updated_at) are accepted in the request body. 

Order items, shipments, and other children are created by related endpoints. This DTO covers only top-level order details for atomic platform order creation.

IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary.description:
Summary actor information for a customer involved in disputes or dispute messages.

Includes essential, non-sensitive public identity and minimum contact details used to reference customers in moderation, dispute, and messaging APIs. Provides list or reference-level identification in composite summary DTOs.

This variant must never expose internal, sensitive, or authentication-related fields, only the minimum needed for reference or selection contexts across dispute flows.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the customer assigned in the platform. This value is globally unique and non-editable.

Used as the primary reference across all platform modules, including dispute resolution, messaging, and administrative actions. Follows standard UUID v4 conventions.

name.description:
Display name or real name of the customer, as shown in dispute resolutions, message senders, and summary or selection lists.

May be the legal name or a nickname per the user's account settings, surfaced wherever identity reference is required short of full profile API exposure.

IShoppingMallAddress.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for Shopping Mall Address entity.

Represents a short, reference-oriented view of an address book entry for shipping, billing, or business association for any user actor. Used for displaying address selections, lists, and foreign key summaries without full relation context or edit information. Contains essential address and contact information; omits relation objects and historical metadata.

Summary DTOs should always include fields needed for transaction, selection, or shipping, but omit cross-actor relations. Actor linkage (customer or seller) is always implied by the embedding API. This summary does not include created_at or relation object references.

id.description: Unique identifier for the address. This serves as the primary key for address records in the shopping mall system and is used for selection, reference, and update APIs.

full_name.description:
Full recipient name as supplied by the user. Used for shipping/billing labels, order records, or business documentation.

For customers, typically the receiving party. For sellers, the business-name or documentation contact. Always required.

street.description: Street address, generally including apartment, suite, floor, or building/unit number as needed by delivery services. This field must contain all information necessary for home/office/facility delivery in the target region.

city.description: City, town, or municipality relating to the delivery or billing address. This should match local government conventions for city naming.

province.description: Province, state, prefecture, or other primary administrative region for the address. Enables proper routing in cross-border and interregional shipments. May affect tax calculations or shipping fees depending on jurisdiction.

postal_code.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the address, following national/local postal authority formatting rules. Required for all delivery and billing addresses.

country.description: Country or territory name following ISO or widely used local conventions for clear internationalization support. Necessary for cross-border shipments, billing, and regulatory compliance.

phone.description: Contact phone number associated with this address. Used for delivery coordination, failed delivery contact, or verification callbacks from shipping or business documentation systems. Must be capable of direct contact with an address occupant or responsible party.

is_default.description:
Indicates whether this address is currently the default for the associated actor (customer or seller).

Default status affects autofill, transactional selection, and serves as the preferred sender/recipient for new orders or business documents.

IShoppingMallOrder.IUpdate.description: DTO for updating high-level fields of an existing order entity in shopping_mall_orders. Used for business order management workflows, such as status updates, address correction, seller assignment, or recalculation of total amounts before payment. This type excludes immutable or system-managed fields like order_number, timestamps, and relations to child entities. Ownership (customer) cannot be changed. Security and business logic strictly enforce update eligibility by status, role, and payment state. All updates are tracked via updated_at and audit trails.

status.description: Current platform order status. May be changed by admin or system workflows according to business policy, but only for allowed states such as paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded. Must be one of the validated order states defined by the platform.

shopping_mall_address_id.description: Reference to the new delivery address, if the order's address is being updated. Must reference a valid address in the shopping_mall_addresses table. Address change is only allowed if the order has not shipped.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Reference to a new assigned seller, if the order is being reassigned before shipment or payment. Must reference a valid and active seller in shopping_mall_sellers.

total_amount.description: Order total amount to be updated before payment is confirmed. Adjustment is only allowed if no payment exists yet for the order.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IRequest.description: Query and filter DTO for searching items in shopping_mall_order_items belonging to a specific order. Used in paginated list and search operations for order item breakdown per order. Supports filtering by SKU, fulfillment status, refund status, and price/quantity. Paging, sorting, and advanced search parameters may be present as well, according to platform conventions for list/search DTOs.

page.description: Page number for paginated query (1-based indexing).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (capped at 100).

sku_id.description: Filter by the product SKU. Must be a valid shopping_mall_product_skus.id.

delivered.description: Filter by item fulfillment status. True returns only delivered items, false returns only not-yet-delivered.

refunded.description: Filter by item refund status. True returns only refunded items, false returns only non-refunded.

min_price.description: Return only items with unit_price >= min_price, if present.

max_price.description: Return only items with unit_price <= max_price, if present.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.description:
Represents a single item in a shopping mall order, corresponding to a specific product SKU purchased as part of a particular transaction.

Each record tracks the details of a per-SKU, per-product purchase, including inventory, fulfillment, and refund attributes. It links to the parent order, the product, and the SKU. This entity is critical for reporting, analytics, and item-level post-order processing in ecommerce workflows.

The DTO now references the parent order, product, and SKU via summary reference objects rather than raw UUIDs. This enables frontend display and linkage, prevents N+1 problems, enables direct context embedding in responses, and removes field redundancy (UUID accessible via .id property of referenced object).

Also contains status flags (delivered, refunded), pricing at purchase time, and timestamps for lifecycle tracking. This structure enables granular tracking of order composition, fulfillment operations, inventory adjustments, and allows for item-level returns and dispute resolution.

id.description:
Unique identifier for this order item.

Primary key, auto-generated UUID that uniquely identifies the individual item record within the shopping_mall_order_items table.

order.description:
Summary object giving parent order context for this item, including order number, status, customer, and main timestamps.

Always referenced as a summary DTO for compactness and to prevent circular expansion. Provides orderNumber, minimal status/identity, and timestamps.

product.description:
Referenced catalog product for this ordered item (summary representation).

Provides name, productId, minimal meta for link, and prevents need to resolve raw product_id in frontend.

sku.description:
The exact SKU (variant) ordered, referenced as summary context object.

Provides variant code, combination name/details, and key identifiers for inventory/analytics UI. Prevents frontend N+1 lookups.

quantity.description:
Quantity of this product SKU purchased in the order.

Specifies how many units of this SKU were ordered. Must be positive and reflect the transaction at purchase time.

unit_price.description:
Unit price for this SKU at the time of order (after discounts, inclusive of adjustments).

Used for accurate order breakdown, reporting, and refund calculation. Should reflect the selling price at the moment of transaction.

subtotal.description:
Subtotal value for this order item (quantity × unit_price) before any order-level discounts or adjustments.

Used for displaying precise order compositions, refund calculations, and analytical reporting.

currency.description:
Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the transaction currency for this item.

Example: "USD", "KRW". Indicates what currency the item was priced and settled in.

delivered.description:
True if this item has been delivered and fulfillment is complete.

This flag is set after shipping and delivery confirmation. Used for workflow state tracking, analytics, and permissioning for returns processing.

refunded.description:
True if this item has been refunded via returns workflow or dispute resolution.

Indicates that the item was subject to a successful refund after fulfillment, or returned/restocked per policy.

created_at.description:
Record creation timestamp for the order item.

Used for chronology, analytics, and audit trails.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp of last update to this order item.

Updated on any status, price, or detail change; supports auditing and reporting.

deleted_at.description:
Soft-deletion timestamp. Set if this item was removed or erased from the parent order; otherwise null if active.

Used for compliance, audit, and business logic enforcing only active records in business flows.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new per-product, per-SKU item within an existing shopping mall order. Used for amending or composing new order items prior to checkout, payment, or fulfillment.

Requires all critical item-level transactional fields: the specific product, the SKU selected, quantity to purchase, inventory pricing at time of request, and initial workflow flags (delivered/refunded). All business validations (availability, uniqueness by order/SKU, etc.) are enforced at the API and service layer.

Parent order context is inferred from URL/path parameter (orderNumber) so is NEVER included in the request body.

This DTO enables order breakdown and normalization conforming to shopping_mall_order_items schema, supports inventory workflows, and enables precise item-level analytics and fulfillment operations.

shopping_mall_product_id.description:
UUID of the product being added to this order item.

References shopping_mall_products.id. Required to tie this item to a catalog product for fulfillment and analytics.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description:
UUID of the SKU (variant) being ordered.

References shopping_mall_product_skus.id. Required for inventory reservation, pricing, and fulfillment.

quantity.description:
Number of units for this SKU in this order item.

Must be a positive integer value, reflecting the desired purchase quantity.

unit_price.description:
Price per single SKU at the moment order item is created.

This value is locked at order time and is used for breakdown, analytics, and refund/adjustment calculation.

subtotal.description:
Computed subtotal for this order item: quantity × unit_price.

Must be consistent with provided quantity/unit_price; used for analytics, display, and consistency checks.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 three-letter code for transaction currency (e.g., "USD", "KRW").

Specifies what currency this item is being purchased and settled in.

delivered.description:
Initial delivered status for this item (typically false on creation).

Indicates whether fulfillment is already complete (rare at creation; most often false until post-shipment tracking confirms delivery).

refunded.description:
Initial refund status for this order item; typically false on creation.

Set only if item is being immediately marked as refunded in an exceptional workflow.

quantity.description: Number of units of this SKU ordered. Value must be positive and is subject to business validation and inventory rules.

unit_price.description: Unit price at the time of order for this SKU (discounts included, if any). Modifying this should be accompanied by validation against current catalog pricing rules and order audit requirements.

delivered.description: True if this item has been marked as delivered in fulfillment tracking. Can only be set according to valid fulfillment or shipping workflow state transitions.

refunded.description: True if this item has been refunded through returns/workflow. Can only be set in accordance with business rules for refund eligibility and item status.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IUpdate.description:
Defines the fields that may be updated for an order item in shopping_mall_order_items.

Allows updating mutable properties such as quantity (bounded by available inventory and business rules), unit price (subject to current catalog pricing audit), and delivery/refund status (subject to business workflow restrictions). Immutable primary and foreign keys are provided in the path and must not appear in the request body. All property changes are audit-logged and enforced with validations. 

This DTO follows the atomic operation principle for partial update of the order item, supporting both business and fulfillment update scenarios.

status.description: Filter shipments by their status, e.g., pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, returned. Use business-defined status values.

tracking_number.description: Filter by the shipping/tracking-provided unique tracking number for this shipment. Usually partial or exact matches.

shipping_partner_id.description: Filter results to only shipments handled by a specific shipping partner.

start_created_at.description: Filter for shipments created at or after this datetime (inclusive). Use in pagination or date-based searches.

end_created_at.description: Filter for shipments created at or before this datetime (inclusive).

page.description: Requested results page number. Default is 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Number of items per page (maximum: 100). Default may be 20 or platform/system configuration.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.IRequest.description:
Filter/search and paging DTO for paginated shipment search within a given order context in shopping_mall_order_shipments.

Allows precise filtering by status, tracking number, shipping partner, and creation date ranges. Pagination is supported through page and limit controls, with sensible platform defaults and maximums enforced. All query fields are optional but should be validated for correctness and business logic. This DTO is used in customer, seller, and admin views to enable efficient browsing and audit of fulfillment batches per order.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.description:
Shipment/fulfillment batch information for a specific order in the shopping mall platform.

Each record represents a discrete logistics event (shipment) related to an order, supporting scenarios such as multi-package, split, staged, or partial deliveries. This entity includes all information needed for business, customer, seller, and admin fulfillment workflows, audit trails, and platform-level shipment analysis.

References the parent order, carrier (shipping partner), and includes shipment attributes such as tracking number, delivery status, various timestamps for lifecycle events, and soft-deletion metadata.

Security policies ensure only order stakeholders or privileged actors can access this detail. The `deleted_at` field represents a logical (soft) delete—records with this timestamp are excluded from standard business logic, supporting compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements. Soft deletion enables reversibility and history-tracking for shipment records without physical data removal.

id.description: Primary key for the shipment entity. Globally unique shipment identifier for audit, system reference, and external integrations.

order.description: Summary of the parent order to which this shipment belongs.

shippingPartner.description: Summary of the linked shipping/logistics partner responsible for this shipment. Enables carrier-level tracking and vendor analysis.

tracking_number.description:
Shipping partner/tracking-provided unique tracking number for this shipment. Uniquely identifies the shipment for customer, carrier, and platform systems.

Field is unique per-shipment and validated for uniqueness in the platform. Use this value for all customer service, carrier tracking, and integration requirements.

status.description:
Current business status of this shipment: e.g., `pending`, `shipped`, `in_transit`, `delivered`, `returned`.

This is a business-enum managed at the service layer. Clients should use platform status mappings. Each status denotes a lifecycle stage and is referenced both internally and in external tracking. Example usages:
- `pending`: Shipment is created, awaiting carrier handover
- `shipped`: Now with carrier/logistics partner
- `in_transit`: Carrier has confirmed pickup, package in delivery pipeline
- `delivered`: Carrier or recipient confirms delivery
- `returned`: Package was returned to sender or depot

oneOf.description: Date/time the shipment was handed off to the logistics partner. Null if not yet shipped.

ship_date.description:
The UTC timestamp for shipment handover to carrier. Nullable for pre-shipment records. 

This timestamp marks the actual transition from platform to carrier for tracking and audit purposes. Often filled programmatically by logistics integration.

oneOf.description: The expected or promised delivery date provided by the carrier or system. Null if not available.

expected_delivery_date.description:
When (if known) the shipment is projected to be delivered to the customer. Nullable if unknown or not set.

Used to forecast delivery experience, inform users, and drive notification triggers.

oneOf.description: Timestamp of confirmed arrival at the recipient's location. Null if not yet delivered.

delivered_at.description:
UTC timestamp of actual delivery confirmation. Nullable if not yet delivered.

Set by carrier integration, manual fulfillment, or customer confirmation. Used in business rules for returns, audits, and SLA tracking.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the shipment record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the last update to this shipment record.

oneOf.description: Soft-deletion timestamp for the shipment record. Null if active.

deleted_at.description:
Logical deletion timestamp for audit/compliance. Records with a non-null value are excluded from normal business logic. 

Soft deletion enables reversibility, ensures compliance, and allows for comprehensive audit trails without permanent removal from the platform.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating a new shipment record for an existing shopping mall order.

Used in POST operations where a platform admin or authorized seller logs a new shipment event for a specific order (identified by order number in the path). Input must strictly exclude any actor, system, or path-provided IDs, as these are injected by the backend and context.

Supports scenarios such as multi-shipment fulfillment, split or staged deliveries, and partnerships with external carriers. All required business and logistics details are included. Does not accept system timestamps, shipment or order IDs, or platform-managed metadata.

shipping_partner_id.description: The unique identifier of the designated shipping/logistics partner responsible for this shipment. Must reference a valid, registered shipping partner (see shipping_mall_shipping_partners).

tracking_number.description: Shipping partner/tracking-provided unique tracking number for this shipment. Used for business, customer, and integration needs. Must be unique across all shipments.

status.description: Initial status assigned to the new shipment: e.g., pending, shipped. Must be compatible with platform fulfillment and workflow rules.

oneOf.description: Date/time the shipment is to be, or was, handed to the logistics partner (if known on creation).

ship_date.description: Optional pre-known handover UTC timestamp to the carrier. May be omitted or null for future-dated or on-demand shipments.

oneOf.description: Planned or promised delivery date, if available, at creation. May be null if undetermined.

expected_delivery_date.description: Projected delivery date at creation, if available. Nullable.

IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary.description:
Summary schema for a shopping mall order.

Represents the most essential information about a single order, optimized for list displays, admin reporting, and relational summaries. In addition to the key identifiers, business status, amounts, and audit timestamps, this summary type also includes the soft delete marker ('deleted_at'), supporting administrative and batch audit use cases. Full detail is available via the main IShoppingMallOrder schema.

id.description: Unique UUID of the order. Primary key. Corresponds to the 'id' column in Prisma model. Used for uniquely identifying orders throughout the system, in URLs, and for audit traceability.

order_number.description: Platform-unique business order number, used for external references and customer support. Example: ORD202500001. This value is unique per order.

status.description: Current platform order status: e.g., pending, paid, cancelled, shipped, delivered, refunded. Use business-defined enum/string values.

total_amount.description: Final order total amount including all items, taxes, shipping, and discounts if any. Sourced directly from the Prisma column. Use double precision.

currency.description: Currency code (ISO 4217), e.g., USD, KRW. Indicates the monetary denomination in which the order was processed.

created_at.description: Order creation timestamp as ISO 8601 string. Always present. Used for audit and reporting.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for this order. Indicates most recent update, including status, items, or shipping changes.

oneOf.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When present, indicates the order was marked deleted for cleanup/audit. Null if the order is active and not deleted.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit/legacy deletion events. Null if order is active.

IShoppingMallShippingPartner.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a registered shipping/logistics partner in the shopping mall platform.

Encapsulates the core information required to identify, display, and manage shipping partners for all order/fulfillment and admin registry workflows. As part of admin/batch processing, includes audit creation/modification timestamps, and the soft-delete nullable timestamp for legacy, deprecated, or decommissioned partners. Full detail and audit context available via referenced Prisma model.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shipping/logistics partner. Primary Key in the database. Used throughout fulfillment, registry, and order workflows.

partner_name.description: Display name of the shipping partner for UIs and reporting. Unique per partner in the system. Sourced from Prisma column.

partner_code.description: Integration code for referencing or mapping the partner in system/business logic. Unique in registry.

status.description: Status for platform use. Typically one of: active, inactive, deprecated. Admins manage this value for controlling availability. See Prisma column for additional business rules.

description.description: Business and operational details about the shipping partner. Used for admin notes, display, registry management, and selection flows.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp for this shipping partner record. Sourced from Prisma. Used for admin audit, registry reconciliation, and management workflows.

updated_at.description: Most recent update timestamp for this shipping partner record. Used for tracking last admin modification, registry updates, or partner API association.

oneOf.description: Soft-deletion timestamp for legacy or decommissioned partners. Null if active.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for legacy/decommissioned partners. Null if partner is active.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.IUpdate.description: Schema for updating a shopping mall order shipment record. This is used in PUT operations for shipment modification. Only modifiable business fields are included; immutable/system fields such as shipment ID or creation time are excluded. Applies to both admin and seller actors authorized to update shipment information. The parent order context is provided via path (orderNumber), so `shopping_mall_order_id` is intentionally omitted to avoid duplication and ambiguity.

shopping_mall_shipping_partner_id.description: Linked shipping partner. References shopping_mall_shipping_partners.id. Modifiable on update if shipment has not yet been shipped.

tracking_number.description: Shipping partner/tracking-provided unique tracking number for this shipment.

status.description: Shipment status: pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, returned. Enum in business logic, validated at service layer.

ship_date.description: Date/time the shipment was handed to logistics partner. Nullable; can be set to null if unshipped.

expected_delivery_date.description: Expected or promised delivery date; nullable if unknown or unset.

IShoppingMallOrderStatusHistory.IRequest.description: Query parameters for paginated/filterable retrieval of order status history events. Defines the fields available for searching, sorting, or paginating status changes for a given order. No x-autobe-prisma-schema because this type represents filter/query input, not a table.

statuses.description: Optionally filter histories to only entries with these to_status values. Array of status strings.

actor_type.description: Filter to only histories performed by a certain actor type (admin, seller, customer, system). Optional; if omitted, all actor types are included.

actor_id.description: Restrict histories to those created by this specific actor (UUID from admin, seller, or customer table). Optional.

from_time.description: Filter to histories created after this time. ISO 8601 timestamp string. Optional.

to_time.description: Filter to histories created before this time. ISO 8601 timestamp string. Optional.

search.description: Free-text query of comment field. Optional. Searches for comment containing the value (may be full-text or LIKE depending on implementation).

page.description: Which page to return (pagination). Default is 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum results per page (pagination). Default 20, max 100.

oneOf.description: Sort key for result ordering. Enum: created_at or status. Default is created_at.
Sort key for result ordering. Enum: created_at or status. Default is created_at.

sort_by.description: Sort key for result ordering. Enum: created_at or status. Default is created_at.

oneOf.description: Sort order (ascending/descending). Enum: asc or desc. Default is desc.
Sort order (ascending/descending). Enum: asc or desc. Default is desc.

sort_order.description: Sort order (ascending/descending). Enum: asc or desc. Default is desc.

IShoppingMallOrderStatusHistory.description: Immutable historical status transition record for a shopping mall order, including full context for related order and all possible actor types (admin, seller, customer).

id.description: Unique immutable identifier (UUID) for the status history record.

order.description: Full business context for the order associated with this status change. Provides order number, key fields for list display, and sufficient information for traceability or UI displays. Prev: shopping_mall_order_id.

from_status.description: Status value prior to the transition. Reflects the old state before this event.

to_status.description: New status value after the transition. Reflects the updated order state due to this event.

comment.description: Optional business or workflow comment recorded during the status change. Used for explanations, notes, or system remarks.

created_at.description: Precise UTC timestamp for when this status transition occurred.

admin.description: Actor summary info for the admin who performed this event, if applicable. Null if not performed by an admin. Prev: actor_admin_id.

seller.description: Actor summary info for the seller who performed this event, if applicable. Null if not performed by a seller. Prev: actor_seller_id.

customer.description: Actor summary info for the customer who performed this event, if applicable. Null if not performed by a customer. Prev: actor_customer_id.

IShoppingMallOrderAuditLog.IRequest.description: Filtering and pagination request type for querying order audit logs.

action_type.description: Optional filter: audit action type (e.g., status_change, address_update). If omitted or null, matches all actions.

from_created_at.description: Optional filter: restrict to events with created_at >= this ISO date-time. Null or omitted disables lower time boundary.

to_created_at.description: Optional filter: restrict to events with created_at <= this ISO date-time. Null or omitted disables upper time boundary.

actor_admin_id.description: Optional filter: restrict to audit events performed by a specific admin (UUID). Null or omitted disables admin filter.

actor_seller_id.description: Optional filter: restrict to audit events performed by a specific seller (UUID). Null or omitted disables seller filter.

actor_customer_id.description: Optional filter: restrict to audit events performed by a specific customer (UUID). Null or omitted disables customer filter.

page.description: 1-based page index for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description: Number of audit log records to include per page (max 100). Defaults as per platform standard.

oneOf.description: Sort field. Allowed values: created_at, action_type. Defaults to created_at.
Sort field. Allowed values: created_at, action_type. Defaults to created_at.

sort_by.description: Sort field. Allowed values: created_at, action_type. Defaults to created_at.

oneOf.description: Sort direction. asc for ascending, desc for descending. Defaults to desc (most recent first).
Sort direction. asc for ascending, desc for descending. Defaults to desc (most recent first).

order_by.description: Sort direction. asc for ascending, desc for descending. Defaults to desc (most recent first).

IShoppingMallOrderAuditLog.description:
Audit log record for a significant action, update, event, or transition in an order's lifecycle on the shopping mall platform.

Each log records an irreversible change event, the actor (admin, seller, or customer), timestamp, action type, context details, and references to both the parent order and any relevant business entity. Instead of exposing raw foreign keys, all contextual relations are provided as summary reference objects, in compliance with DTO relation rules.

This aligns with business rules for traceability and legal non-repudiation. The presence of at least one actor summary (admin, seller, or customer) is required depending on who performed the underlying order event.

Order and actor references are always summary objects. The log is append-only, supports compliance, dispute resolution, and audit tracing, and is never modifiable or deletable after recording.

id.description: Primary key identifying the audit log record.

order.description: Parent order associated with this audit event.

admin.description: Admin actor summary if this event was performed by an admin, otherwise null.

seller.description: Seller actor summary if this event was performed by a seller, otherwise null.

customer.description: Customer actor summary if this event was performed by a customer, otherwise null.

action_type.description: Type of audited action (e.g., status_change, address_update, refund_initiated). Used for filtering, compliance review, and event categorization.

details_json.description: Optional serialized contextual details for this action as a JSON string. May contain additional information about the event. If not applicable, null.

created_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this audit event was recorded. This field is immutable and reflects the true time of event persistence.

IShoppingMallPayment.IRequest.description:
Request DTO for searching, filtering, and paginating shopping mall payment records.

Provides a structured interface for specifying exact query options when searching payments for reconciliation, reporting, or dashboard display. Includes flexible filters by status, method type, date ranges, customer or provider reference, transaction tokens, amount ranges, and sorting options.

All fields are optional; only specified filters are applied. Pagination and ordering are included to support listing large data sets. Used in PATCH /shoppingMall/admin/payments.

status.description: Exact payment status for filtering (e.g., initiated, pending, authorized, rejected, completed, refunded, failed). Null if status filter not used.

method_type.description: Payment method type to include (e.g., card, e-wallet, bank_transfer). Null if no method type filter.

currency.description: Currency code (ISO 4217, e.g., USD, KRW, EUR) for filtering payments. Null to include all currencies.

customer_id.description: Filter by customer making the payment. Null for all customers.

provider_id.description: Filter by external payment provider. Null to include all providers.

external_payment_id.description: Lookup by exact payment transaction ID assigned by the provider. Null if not searching by this field.

transaction_token.description: Lookup by unique transaction token (system-generated). Null for all tokens.

min_amount.description: Minimum payment amount (inclusive) for filtering. Null for no lower bound.

max_amount.description: Maximum payment amount (inclusive). Null for no upper bound.

requested_from.description: Filter payments requested after this timestamp (inclusive). UTC ISO 8601 format. Null for no lower bound.

requested_to.description: Filter payments requested up to this timestamp (inclusive). Null for no upper bound.

processed_from.description: Filter payments processed after this timestamp (inclusive). Null for no lower bound.

processed_to.description: Filter payments processed up to this timestamp (inclusive). Null for no upper bound.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page. Default and maximum as per API specification.

order_by.description: Field to sort results by (e.g., requested_at, processed_at, amount). Null for default ordering.

order_dir.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Null for default (usually desc by date).

IShoppingMallPayment.description:
Primary payment record entity for all customer orders processed by the shopping mall platform.

Represents each initiated or completed payment for one or more customer orders on the system. Includes core financial amounts (decimal in specified currency), the associated customer actor, the external payment provider used, payment status, and both internal and provider reference tokens. Provides timestamps for payment lifecycle tracking, such as when payment is requested, processed (success/failure/refund), as well as audit log purposes. The record soft deletes via a nullable deleted_at field. This is the main entity used for all system payment reconciliation, administrative audits, and payment-channel integrations.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the payment record.

customer.description: Summary of the customer (shopping_mall_customers) who is the payment actor.

provider.description: Summary of the external payment provider (shopping_mall_external_payment_providers).

amount.description: Decimal amount in the specified currency for this payment. Must be positive and match order value.

status.description: Current payment status. Values: initiated, pending, authorized, rejected, completed, refunded, failed.

external_payment_id.description: External payment provider's transaction ID. Used for reconciliation and callbacks.

transaction_token.description: Opaque unique token for idempotent processing, generated by the system.

requested_at.description: Timestamp when the payment was initially requested.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of payment processor's definitive outcome (success/failure/refund). Null if not processed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the last modification to this record.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when active, set when deleted for audit/compliance.

IShoppingMallPayment.ICreate.description:
Payload to create a new payment entity in the shopping mall payments table.

All fields required to initiate a payment, including references to the customer and payment provider, amount, currency, method type, status (such as initiated/pending), external provider and transaction identifiers, as well as the request timestamp. 'transaction_token' assures idempotency for retry scenarios. Only privileged administrative actors can use this interface. Audit, processed, and deletion timestamps are system-managed and not included in the submission.

customer_id.description: Reference to the customer actor making the payment (shopping_mall_customers.id).

provider_id.description: Reference to the external payment provider (shopping_mall_external_payment_providers.id).

amount.description: Decimal amount of the payment. Must be positive and correspond to order value.

status.description: Initial payment status (usually 'initiated' or 'pending').

external_payment_id.description: External provider's transaction ID, as returned by the integrated payment channel.

transaction_token.description: Unique idempotency token for submission, generated per payment attempt.

requested_at.description: Timestamp when payment was requested (should be provided at the point of creation).

IShoppingMallPayment.IUpdate.description:
Data Transfer Object for partially updating a shopping mall payment record (PATCH/PUT update semantics, all fields optional).

This DTO allows administrative actors or automated system flows to update selected mutable properties of an existing payment record, such as payment status, processed timestamp, audit timestamp, and soft delete timestamp ('deleted_at'). All fields are optional to support true partial update for compliance with OpenAPI best practices, even if business validation rules may require at least one non-null property at runtime.

Fields like 'amount', 'currency', 'transaction_token', and 'external_payment_id' are strictly immutable after creation and are thus omitted from this DTO. The DTO directly reflects the Prisma shopping_mall_payments model for mutable fields (including soft-delete changes).

Every update operation refreshes the 'updated_at' timestamp for audit purposes. Any change to 'deleted_at' (ie. soft deletion by admin/system) must also update 'updated_at' and be logged for compliance.

Key business rules include:
- Allowed status transitions are controlled by server-side logic
- 'processed_at' may be set/cleared by external payment notifications or admin review
- 'deleted_at' enables soft delete, and should only be set by privileged actors
- API only exposes updatable fields, and never allows actor identity or system-managed (immutable) fields from the client

This DTO is mapped directly to the shopping_mall_payments table and is aligned to platform audit/compliance requirements.

status.description: The new payment status (e.g., pending, authorized, completed, refunded, failed). Only valid transitions may be permitted according to business rules.

oneOf.description: Datetime string (ISO 8601) marking when payment processing was finalized (success/failure/refund).
Explicitly null if not finalized.

processed_at.description: Datetime when payment was processed (or null if pending).

updated_at.description: Datetime string (ISO 8601) when the record was last updated (audit/compliance).

oneOf.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) for soft deleting this payment. Null if record is active.
Explicitly null if payment should be restored/undeleted.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp or null to restore; supports admin/system-initiated soft deletion (compliance with shopping_mall_payments.deleted_at).

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.IRequest.description:
DTO for filtering and paginating refund searches for a specific payment. Used as the request body when listing refunds for a given payment ID. Includes filtering criteria such as refund status, date ranges, refund amount ranges, and pagination/sorting controls. The API will return a paginated list of refund summaries based on these criteria.

Supported search filters include:
- status: filter by refund status string (e.g., 'completed', 'pending')
- min_amount, max_amount: range filters on refund amount
- requested_from, requested_to: restrict search to refunds requested within a temporal interval
- sort_by, sort_order: supports sorting by requested_at, amount, or status, with ascending/descending selection
- page, page_size: standard pagination controls

No direct actor IDs are included in this DTO; access control is enforced separately by authentication/authorization.

All properties are optional (if omitted, defaults apply).

status.description: Refund status to filter by (e.g., 'completed', 'pending', 'failed', 'rejected'). Optional.

min_amount.description: Minimum refund amount to include in search results. Optional.

max_amount.description: Maximum refund amount to include in search results. Optional.

requested_from.description: Restrict results to refunds requested on or after this date/time (ISO 8601). Optional.

requested_to.description: Restrict results to refunds requested on or before this date/time (ISO 8601). Optional.

oneOf.description: Field to sort refunds by. Supported: 'requested_at', 'amount', 'status'. Optional.
Field to sort refunds by. Supported: 'requested_at', 'amount', 'status'. Optional.
Field to sort refunds by. Supported: 'requested_at', 'amount', 'status'. Optional.

sort_by.description: Field to sort refunds by. Supported: 'requested_at', 'amount', 'status'. Optional.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Optional.
Sort order: ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Optional.

sort_order.description: Sort order: ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Optional.

page.description: Page number for pagination (starting from 1). Optional, defaults to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (max 100). Optional, defaults to 20.

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.description:
Payment refund record entity for the shopping mall platform.

All BELONGS-TO relations use .ISummary object references. Foreign key scalars (`payment_id`, `processed_by_admin_id`) have been replaced with full structural references for consistency, N+1 prevention, and client context.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for this refund record.

payment.description: Summary of the original payment being refunded. Transforms the contextual BELONGS-TO relation to full payment reference for business context, audit operations, and N+1 prevention.

processed_by_admin.description: Summary of the admin who processed the refund, if any (admin-processed refunds). This is null for system/automation refunds and present otherwise.

amount.description: Amount of money refunded, in the same currency as the original payment. Must be less than or equal to the original payment amount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the refund (e.g., USD, KRW).

reason.description: Reason the refund was issued (such as cancellation, item not delivered, admin override, etc.).

status.description: Status of the refund event, such as: requested, pending, processing, completed, failed, or rejected.

external_refund_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to this refund transaction by the payment provider, for auditing and traceability.

requested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp representing when this refund was requested in the system.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when refund processing was completed/finalized. Null if not yet processed.
Null if refund has not been finalized or processed.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when refund processing completed, failed, or was finalized; null if still open.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the refund record was created in the database.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the refund record was last modified.

oneOf.description: Soft delete timestamp if the record was deleted; present if refund was deleted.
Null if the refund record is active and not deleted.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion of record; null if record is active.

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.ICreate.description:
Request parameters for issuing a new payment refund linked to a payment.

Used in POST /shoppingMall/admin/payments/{paymentId}/refunds to register a new refund record for a specific payment. Includes required business fields for refunding: the refund amount, reason, currency, status, and the provider refund identifier, if available. actor/admin IDs are omitted, as the actor is determined by authorization context. 

External provider refund identifiers and manual admin processing fields are optional. The system will auto-link the refund record to the relevant payment using the paymentId path parameter, not a request body field.

amount.description: Amount to refund, in the same currency as the original payment. Must be positive and not exceed the original payment total.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for refunded amount.

reason.description: Reason for the refund (required by business policy and for audit tracking).

status.description: Initial status of the refund process: e.g., requested, pending, or processing. Typically set to 'requested' when refund is initiated.

external_refund_id.description: Identifier for this refund assigned by the payment provider (optional, for audit-trace), if present at creation.

status.description: Refund status for the update operation. Acceptable values are constrained by business logic and must represent a valid status transition as dictated by platform policies. Typical examples include: 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed', or 'rejected', but allowed transitions depend on the refund's current state and compliance rules.

reason.description: Reason for modifying the refund. This field should describe why the refund is being updated (e.g., new provider information, error resolution, business policy enforcement, manual override, etc.).

external_refund_id.description: Updated refund transaction identifier from the external payment provider if new details must be set for reconciliation or correction. Must uniquely identify the refund in the provider context if specified.

processed_by_admin_id.description: UUID of the admin manually executing or updating this refund record. Nullable—include only if an explicit admin actor is performing this update. System- or automation-driven updates must not supply a value here.

processed_at.description: Timestamp for when this refund was processed, completed, failed, or otherwise resolved by the update. Must be populated only if the status transition is from a non-final to a final state or if required by the update event.

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for a payment refund (shopping_mall_payment_refunds).

Enables authorized administrators to amend the status, provider reference, administrative details, or business resolution tracking for a specific refund record. All transitions are validated against business rules and platform compliance policies.

Only fields permitted by the current business rules and refund workflow are accepted in an update. Permission to perform updates is restricted to admin roles. Null values in processed_by_admin_id and processed_at are permitted for system or automated transitions.

page.description: Page number for paginated status history results. Must be greater than zero.

limit.description: Maximum number of status history records per page. System may impose an upper bound; values typically between 1 and 100.

sort.description: Sort field for the history entries (e.g., 'changed_at', 'new_status'). Determines the order of result presentation.

oneOf.description: Sort order for pagination—'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Platform typically defaults to descending order for most recent events first.
Sort order for pagination—'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Platform typically defaults to descending order for most recent events first.

order.description: Sort order for pagination—'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Platform typically defaults to descending order for most recent events first.

search.description: Free text search term for status transitions or reasons. Performs a simple match on the reason or status values to narrow down audit trail results.

status.description: Specific target status value to filter for in the history search (e.g., 'completed', 'failed', 'pending', 'refunded'). Allows API clients to find specific events.

changed_by_admin_id.description: Filters audit trail results to only those status changes initiated by a particular admin. Useful for compliance reviews or investigation of specific operator actions.

IShoppingMallPaymentStatus.IRequest.description:
Query/search DTO for fetching paginated payment status history.

Supports pagination, sorting, and various filters for admins reviewing status transition audit logs for payments. Used as request body in status history search endpoints for financial compliance and platform audits.

All parameters are optional; omitted fields will default to platform-wide fallback values (e.g., page=1, limit=20, order='desc').

IShoppingMallPaymentStatus.description:
Represents an individual immutable status transition event for a payment transaction as logged in the payment status history table.

Encapsulates audit details for each state change, including prior/new status values, who enacted the change (admin reference when available), the business reason, and the timestamp. Used for compliance, investigation, and traceability in the payment workflow.

Immutable records; created by the payment processing layer or admins, never end-user modifiable.

id.description: Primary key for this payment status transition event.

payment_id.description: Reference to the payment whose status event is being recorded.

old_status.description: Previous status value prior to this state transition.

new_status.description: The new status for the payment as a consequence of this event; e.g., 'pending', 'authorised', 'completed', 'failed', 'refunded', etc.

changed_reason.description: Free-text/bounded reason for the state change, audit/reference context for compliance investigation or support workflow.

changed_at.description: Exact business timestamp of the status event occurrence, stored in UTC.

changed_by_admin_id.description: When this event was directly triggered by an admin actor, this field references their admin ID. Null if the event was performed by automatic payment system logic or external event.

IShoppingMallPaymentAuditLog.IRequest.description:
Defines the filter, search, and pagination options for querying audit log entries for a specific payment. Used in admin/audit endpoints to retrieve relevant action records based on multiple criteria.

Allows record filtering by action type, actor IDs, date/time range, and supports result pagination and result sorting. Only accessible by admin-level audit interfaces. Not directly mapped to DB tables.

action_types.description: Restricts results to audit logs where the action_type value matches any supplied value(s). Empty or omitted means no filtering by action type.

actor_admin_id.description: Restricts results to logs attributed to this admin. Null/omitted means no filtering for admin actors.

actor_seller_id.description: Restricts results to logs attributed to this seller. Null/omitted means no filtering for seller actors.

actor_customer_id.description: Restricts results to logs attributed to this customer. Null/omitted means no filtering for customer actors.

start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC date-time string. Only logs with created_at >= start_date will be included. Null or omitted means no lower time bound.

end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC date-time string. Only logs with created_at <= end_date will be included. Null or omitted means no upper time bound.

page.description: The page number for paginated results. Required; defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of audit log entries per page.

oneOf.description: Field to use for sorting, must be 'created_at' (default/recommended), or 'action_type' for action grouping views.
Field to use for sorting, must be 'created_at' (default/recommended), or 'action_type' for action grouping views.

sort_by.description: Field to use for sorting, must be 'created_at' (default/recommended), or 'action_type' for action grouping views.

oneOf.description: Direction of sorting: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Default is 'desc' (recent-first).
Direction of sorting: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Default is 'desc' (recent-first).

sort_direction.description: Direction of sorting: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Default is 'desc' (recent-first).

reviewId.description: Filter by specific Review UUID. Optional. Use this for direct lookup or audits.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Filter by product ID to search for all reviews related to a specific product. Corresponds to products in shopping_mall_products.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: Filter by product SKU ID to narrow review searches to a specific product variant or option. Corresponds to shopping_mall_product_skus.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Filter by customer ID to find reviews written by a specific customer. Useful for moderation and fraud investigation.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Filter reviews by referencing the order in which product was purchased. Supports tracing reviews to transactions.

shopping_mall_order_item_id.description: Filter by order item for granular per-item tracing of product reviews.

moderation_status.description: Filter reviews by current moderation status. Supported values vary by business rules, e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'flagged', etc.

is_draft.description: If true, returns only draft/incomplete reviews; if false, returns only published reviews.

withdrawn.description: If true, returns only withdrawn (user-removed) reviews; false excludes withdrawn. Used for moderation/visibility.
